sections.title: Schedule Billing Creation
sections.en: Schedule Billing Creation (F1519) Application Type: Transactional This app is used to create background billing jobs for the creation of invoices for sales docu- ments. The input parameters into the app include scheduling options such as job template (select from a dropdown list), job name (free text), the Start Immediately flag, start date and time, and recurrence pattern (select as single run or recurring). You also can set billing data, such as billing date from, billing date to, and billing type; organizational data, such as sales area, shipping point, and sales and distribution document; and customer data such as sold-to party, destination country, and region. It is also possible to copy an existing job to create a simi- lar version. All parameters are copied. Tip The job will automatically post all created bill- ing documents to accounting, unless the Block posting to accounting checkbox is selected. If this is selected, then the docu- ments must be posted to accounting manu- ally using the Manage Billing Documents (F0797) app or Transaction VA02 (Change Bill- ing Documents).
sections.he:
**Schedule Billing Creation (תזמון יצירת Billing)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת background billing jobs ליצירת invoices עבור sales documents. פרמטרי הקלט לאפליקציה כוללים אפשרויות scheduling כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown), job name (טקסט חופשי), דגל Start Immediately, start date and time, ו-recurrence pattern (בחירה כ-single run או recurring). ניתן גם להגדיר נתוני billing, כגון billing date from, billing date to, ו-billing type; נתונים ארגוניים, כגון sales area, shipping point, ו-sales and distribution document; ונתוני customer כגון sold-to party, destination country, ו-region. ניתן גם להעתיק job קיים ליצירת גרסה דומה. כל הפרמטרים מועתקים.
**טיפ:** ה-job ירשום אוטומטית את כל ה-billing documents שנוצרו ל-accounting, אלא אם נבחר ה-checkbox Block posting to accounting. אם נבחר, אז יש לרשום את המסמכים ל-accounting ידנית באמצעות אפליקציית Manage Billing Documents (F0797) או Transaction VF02 (Change Billing Documents).

sections.title: Schedule Billing Creation for Preliminary Billing Documents
sections.en: Schedule Billing Creation for Preliminary Billing Documents (F5137) Application Type: Transactional A preliminary billing document is used during customer negotiations, and before the details of the billing are confirmed. As soon as the agree- ment with the customer has been established, the preliminary billing document can be output but is not posted to accounting. These docu- ments are often also called proforma billing doc- uments. They can be finalized by creating another subsequent standard billing document with reference to the sales document or delivery in the usual fashion. This app is used to create background billing jobs for the creation of invoices for preliminary billing documents. The input parameters into the app include schedul- ing options such as job template (select from a dropdown list), job name (free text), the Start Immediately flag, start date and time, and recur- rence pattern (select as single run or recurring). You also can set billing data, such as billing date from, billing date to, billing type, preliminary billing document, and the only finalized docu- ments checkbox; organizational data, such as sales area; and customer data, such as sold-to party and destination country. It is also possible Personal Copy for 3 Sales and Distribution 350 to copy an existing job to create a similar ver- sion. All parameters are copied. Tip The job will automatically post all created bill- ing documents to accounting, unless the Block posting to accounting checkbox is selected. If this is selected, then the docu- ments must be posted to accounting manu- ally using the Manage Billing Documents (F0797) app or the Change Billing Documents (VA02) transaction.
sections.he:
**Schedule Billing Creation for Preliminary Billing Documents (תזמון יצירת Billing עבור Preliminary Billing Documents)** — Application Type: Transactional.
preliminary billing document משמש במהלך משא ומתן עם לקוחות, ולפני אישור פרטי ה-billing. ברגע שההסכם עם הלקוח נקבע, ניתן להפיק את ה-preliminary billing document אך הוא אינו נרשם ל-accounting. מסמכים אלה נקראים לעיתים גם proforma billing documents. ניתן לסיימם על ידי יצירת standard billing document עוקב נוסף בהפניה ל-sales document או delivery באופן הרגיל. אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת background billing jobs ליצירת invoices עבור preliminary billing documents. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים אפשרויות scheduling כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown), job name (טקסט חופשי), דגל Start Immediately, start date and time, ו-recurrence pattern (single run או recurring). ניתן גם להגדיר נתוני billing, כגון billing date from, billing date to, billing type, preliminary billing document, ו-checkbox ה-only finalized documents; נתונים ארגוניים, כגון sales area; ונתוני customer, כגון sold-to party ו-destination country. ניתן גם להעתיק job קיים ליצירת גרסה דומה. כל הפרמטרים מועתקים.
**טיפ:** ה-job ירשום אוטומטית את כל ה-billing documents שנוצרו ל-accounting, אלא אם נבחר ה-checkbox Block posting to accounting. אם נבחר, אז יש לרשום את המסמכים ל-accounting ידנית באמצעות אפליקציית Manage Billing Documents (F0797) או transaction ה-Change Billing Documents (VF02).

sections.title: Schedule Billing Output
sections.en: Schedule Billing Output (F1510) Application Type: Transactional This app is used to create background jobs to create output documents for billing documents. It is possible to create, display, cancel, copy, and edit background jobs within the app. The input parameters into the app include job details such as job template (select from a dropdown list), job name (free text), the Start Immediately flag, and the start date and time. You also can set output data such as output channel (i.e. email, print, etc.) and billing data such as billing document, billing date from, sales organization, distribu- tion channel, division, sold-to party, payer, and destination country. Tip There are performance and restriction consid- erations to be aware of with this app. For example, the selection boxes for sales organi- zation, distribution channel, division, and des- tination country, all allow multiple selections. However, selecting multiple options will cause an error in the job. Therefore, only spec- ify a single value or no value at all in these fields. In addition, outputting billing documents that have over 1,000 items on them to print or email will cause errors with Adobe Document Services when it attempts to render to PDF.
sections.he:
**Schedule Billing Output (תזמון Output של Billing)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת background jobs ליצירת output documents עבור billing documents. ניתן ליצור, להציג, לבטל, להעתיק ולערוך background jobs בתוך האפליקציה. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים פרטי job כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown), job name (טקסט חופשי), דגל Start Immediately, ו-start date and time. ניתן גם להגדיר נתוני output כגון output channel (כלומר email, print, וכו') ונתוני billing כגון billing document, billing date from, sales organization, distribution channel, division, sold-to party, payer, ו-destination country.
**טיפ:** קיימים שיקולי ביצועים והגבלות שיש להיות מודעים אליהם עם אפליקציה זו. לדוגמה, תיבות הבחירה עבור sales organization, distribution channel, division, ו-destination country, כולן מאפשרות בחירות מרובות. עם זאת, בחירת אפשרויות מרובות תגרום לשגיאה ב-job. לכן, ציין רק ערך יחיד או לא ערך כלל בשדות אלה. בנוסף, output של billing documents בעלי מעל 1,000 items עליהם ל-print או email יגרום לשגיאות עם Adobe Document Services כאשר הוא מנסה ל-render ל-PDF.

sections.title: Schedule Billing Release
sections.en: Schedule Billing Release (F1518) Application Type: Transactional This app is used to create accounting entries for all billing documents that have previously not been passed to financial accounting. The input parameters into the app include scheduling options such as job template (select from a drop- down list) and job name (free text), as well as parameters such as payer, sales organization, billing document, billing type, billing category, created by, and creation date. You can use the app to create accounting entries restricted to documents that have not yet been posted for specific reasons. These reasons are listed in the selection criteria under the Incomplete due to section. The available reasons are: ▪ Pricing error: The document contains at least one pricing error, such as missing mandatory condition. ▪ Accounting block: The document or cus- tomer has been blocked for posting to accounting. ▪ Error in accounting interface: Normally refers to errors in account determination but also includes attempts to post to a closed account- ing period. ▪ Error in authorization: The user posting the document to accounting did not have suffi- cient authorization to complete the task. It is also possible to copy an existing job to cre- ate a similar version. All parameters are copied.
sections.he:
**Schedule Billing Release (תזמון שחרור Billing)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת accounting entries עבור כל ה-billing documents שלא הועברו קודם ל-financial accounting. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים אפשרויות scheduling כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן פרמטרים כגון payer, sales organization, billing document, billing type, billing category, created by, ו-creation date. ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה ליצירת accounting entries המוגבלים למסמכים שטרם נרשמו מסיבות ספציפיות. סיבות אלה מפורטות בקריטריוני הבחירה תחת החלק Incomplete due to. הסיבות הזמינות הן:
▪ Pricing error: המסמך מכיל לפחות pricing error אחד, כגון condition חובה חסר.
▪ Accounting block: המסמך או הלקוח נחסם לרישום ל-accounting.
▪ Error in accounting interface: בדרך כלל מתייחס לשגיאות ב-account determination אך כולל גם ניסיונות לרשום ל-accounting period סגור.
▪ Error in authorization: המשתמש הרושם את המסמך ל-accounting לא היה בעל authorization מספיק להשלמת המשימה.
ניתן גם להעתיק job קיים ליצירת גרסה דומה. כל הפרמטרים מועתקים.

sections.title: Schedule BOP Run
sections.en: Schedule BOP Run (F2665) Application Type: Transactional This app is used to create background jobs for backorder processing (BOP) runs. The input parameters into the app include general infor- mation such as job template (select from a drop- down list) and job name (free text) and schedul- ing options such as the Start Immediately flag, recurrence pattern (select single run or recur- ring), and start date and time. You also can select © 351 3 Sales and Distribution parameters such as creation date, created by, last change date, changed by, variant name (mandatory), delivery group option, and parallel document update profile. It is possible to run the job in simulation mode by selecting the Sim- ulation Mode checkbox. The results can be displayed in the Monitor BOP Run app (F2159).
sections.he:
**Schedule BOP Run (תזמון BOP Run)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת background jobs עבור backorder processing (BOP) runs. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים מידע כללי כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי) ואפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. ניתן גם לבחור פרמטרים כגון creation date, created by, last change date, changed by, variant name (חובה), delivery group option, ו-parallel document update profile. ניתן להריץ את ה-job במצב simulation על ידי בחירת ה-checkbox Simulation Mode.
ניתן להציג את התוצאות באפליקציית Monitor BOP Run (F2159).

sections.title: Schedule Business Partner Screening – Watch List Screening
sections.en: Schedule Business Partner Screening – Watch List Screening (F8016) Application Type: Transactional SAP Watch List Screening is a service offered by SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), which must be licensed separately. The service screens the customers and suppliers and returns information regarding the viability of doing business with the partner. As part of the interna- tional trade suite of apps, this app allows you to schedule a background job to transfer custom- ers and suppliers to SAP Watch List Screening for individual or all business partners with the defined roles created. The input parameters into the app include template selection parameters such as job template (select from a dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as schedul- ing options such as the Start Immediately flag, recurrence pattern (select single run or recur- ring), and start date and time. You also can set customer/supplier-specific parameters such as business partner number.
sections.he:
**Schedule Business Partner Screening – Watch List Screening (תזמון Business Partner Screening – Watch List Screening)** — Application Type: Transactional.
SAP Watch List Screening הוא שירות המוצע על ידי SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), שיש לרשותו בנפרד. השירות מבצע screening ל-customers ו-suppliers ומחזיר מידע בנוגע לכדאיות עשיית עסקים עם ה-partner. כחלק מחבילת אפליקציות ה-international trade, אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לתזמן background job להעברת customers ו-suppliers ל-SAP Watch List Screening עבור business partners בודדים או כולם עם ה-roles המוגדרים שנוצרו. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים פרמטרי template selection כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן אפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. ניתן גם להגדיר פרמטרים ספציפיים-customer/supplier כגון business partner number.

sections.title: Schedule Content Request to Data Provider – Commodity Codes
sections.en: Schedule Content Request to Data Provider – Commodity Codes (F3051) Application Type: Transactional Commodity codes can be provided by external content providers and uploaded into SAP for use within the suite of apps for international trade. With this app, you can schedule a background job to retrieve new versions of the list of com- modity codes available, for updating SAP. This allows the commodity codes to be kept up to date. The app shows several fields for the data that has been retrieved: version (number of the data package, assigned by the data provider), revision, version type (initial or delta), data pro- vider ID, consistency status (Not Checked, Not Consistent, or Consistent), application status (Not Checked, Not Activatable, Activatable), application log, and data selection (restrictions by numbering scheme and data provider are available). The versions provided can then be used in the Manage Content from Data Provider – Com- modity Codes app (F3429).
sections.he:

sections.title: Schedule Contract Settlement – Customer Contracts
sections.en: Schedule Contract Settlement – Customer Contracts (F2202) Application Type: Transactional Condition contracts can be set up for payment to customers. With this app, you can create background jobs for the creation of settlement documents for the settlement of customer con- dition contracts. Multiple selection options are available for the creation of the job, including template selection parameters such as job tem- plate (select from a dropdown list) and job name (free text); scheduling options such as the Start Immediately flag, recurrence pattern (single run or recurring), and start date and time; settle- ment control options such as settlement date; and contract selection options such as condition contract number, condition contract type, and condition contract category. It is possible to use this app to perform multiple functions, such as the creation of periodic back- ground jobs, receiving notifications for failed jobs, and monitoring and displaying informa- tion about the scheduled jobs.

sections.title: Schedule Creation of Preliminary Billing Documents
sections.en: Schedule Creation of Preliminary Billing Documents (F4563) Application Type: Transactional A preliminary billing document is used during customer negotiations, and before the details of the billing are confirmed. As soon as the agree- ment with the customer has been established, the preliminary billing document can be output but is not posted to accounting. These docu- ments are often also called proforma billing doc- uments. They can be finalized by creating another subsequent standard billing document with reference to the sales document or delivery in the usual fashion. This app is used to create preliminary billing documents from the billing due list. The input parameters in the app include scheduling options such as job template (select from a drop- down list), job name (free text), the Start Imme- diately flag, start date and time, and recurrence pattern (select as single run or recurring), as well as parameters such as billing date from and bill- ing date to, billing type, and preliminary billing document. You also can set organizational data such as sales area, shipping point, and sales and distribution document and customer data such as sold-to party and destination country. It is also possible to copy an existing job to cre- ate a similar version. All parameters are copied.
sections.he:
**Schedule Creation of Preliminary Billing Documents (תזמון יצירת Preliminary Billing Documents)** — Application Type: Transactional.
preliminary billing document משמש במהלך משא ומתן עם לקוחות, ולפני אישור פרטי ה-billing. ברגע שההסכם עם הלקוח נקבע, ניתן להפיק את ה-preliminary billing document אך הוא אינו נרשם ל-accounting. מסמכים אלה נקראים לעיתים גם proforma billing documents. ניתן לסיימם על ידי יצירת standard billing document עוקב נוסף בהפניה ל-sales document או delivery באופן הרגיל.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירת preliminary billing documents מה-billing due list. פרמטרי הקלט כוללים אפשרויות scheduling כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown), job name (טקסט חופשי), דגל Start Immediately, start date and time, ו-recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), וכן פרמטרים כגון billing date from ו-billing date to, billing type, ו-preliminary billing document. ניתן גם להגדיר נתונים ארגוניים כגון sales area, shipping point, ו-sales and distribution document ונתוני customer כגון sold-to party ו-destination country.
ניתן גם להעתיק job קיים ליצירת גרסה דומה. כל הפרמטרים מועתקים.

ב-settlement management של SAP S/4HANA, כאשר condition contract נוצר, מקובל ליצור settlement date. ה-settlement date מתייחס לתאריך שבו המערכת קובעת ומבצעת את ה-settlement של סכומים שנצברו כגון rebates, commissions, או bonuses, עבור customer, supplier, או partner. זהו התאריך המשמש להפעלת יצירת settlement documents כגון credit memos ו-debit memos. ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו ליצירת background jobs לעדכון ה-settlement calendar ב-condition contracts. אפשרויות בחירה מרובות זמינות ליצירת ה-job, כולל פרמטרי template selection כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן אפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. אפשרויות פרמטר כוללות condition contract type, semantic type, condition contract category, condition contract, contract process variant, reference, assignment, created by, created on, supplier, customer, ו-status.
ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו לביצוע פונקציות מרובות, כגון יצירת background jobs תקופתיים, קבלת התראות עבור jobs שנכשלו, וניטור והצגת מידע על ה-jobs המתוזמנים.

sections.title: Schedule Update Settlement Calendar – External Agent Contracts
sections.en: Schedule Update Settlement Calendar – External Agent Contracts (F6875) Application Type: Transactional In SAP S/4HANA settlement management, when a condition contract is created, it is normal to create a settlement date. The settlement date refers to the date on which the system deter- mines and executes the settlement of accrued amounts such as rebates, commissions, or bonuses, for a customer, supplier, or partner. It is the date used to trigger the creation of settle- ment documents such as credit memos and debit memos. This app can be used to create background jobs to update the settlement calen- dar in external agent condition contracts. Multi- ple selection options are available for the cre- ation of the job, including template selection parameters such as job template (select from a dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as scheduling options such as the Start Immedi- ately flag, recurrence pattern (single run or recurring), and start date and time. Parameter options include condition contract type, condi- tion contract category, condition contract, con- tract process variant, reference, assignment, cre- ated by, created on, supplier, customer, and status. It is possible to use this app to perform multiple functions, such as the creation of periodic back- ground jobs, receiving notifications for failed jobs, and monitoring and displaying informa- tion about the scheduled jobs. Personal Copy for 3 Sales and Distribution 366

sections.title: Scheduling Worklist Jobs – Condition Contract Settlement
sections.en: Scheduling Worklist Jobs – Condition Contract Settlement (F7138) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can monitor any scheduled jobs for the settlement of condition contracts. The list of jobs is displayed in tabular format and can be searched using a free search against the job name. Additional filters include status and date from-to. It is possible, using the quick actions icons, to create, copy, view details, cancel, and restart the jobs by selecting from the list.

sections.title: Select Dispatches and Customer Returns – Intrastat Declaration
sections.en: Select Dispatches and Customer Returns – Intrastat Declaration (F2507) Application Type: Transactional Intrastat declarations are a key part of SAP S/4HANA for international trade. With this app, you can schedule background jobs to read dis- patches and customer returns based on SAP bill- ing documents in order to create Intrastat decla- © 367 3 Sales and Distribution rations. New jobs can be created or copied from existing jobs. Existing jobs also can be canceled. Multiple selection options are available for the creation of the job, including template selection parameters such as job template (select from a dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as scheduling options such as the Start Immedi- ately flag, recurrence pattern (single run or recurring), and start date and time. Parameter options include provider of info, declaration year, and declaration month.

sections.title: Settle Route Data
sections.en: Settle Route Data (F4242) Application Type: Transactional Routes in SAP S/4HANA can be displayed using this app, with various features enabled in order to update the route. The full route and settle- ment information can be displayed in the app, with a process flow shown between each step. Each step in the process flow can be selected to see more information related to the route. The following features are available: ▪ Add customer documents to the route ▪ Assign inventory groups ▪ Record payments ▪ Identify differences in the check out and check in process and rectify them ▪ Identify and change products loaded and unloaded during stops ▪ Check whether tolerances have been exceeded by using tolerance groups ▪ Settle routes in foreground or schedule in background Navigation to various related apps is supported, such as Outbound Delivery (S/4HANA) (F0233A), Returns Delivery (S/4HANA) (F0234A), Manage Billing Documents (F0797), Material Documents Overview (F1077), and Sales Order (S/4HANA) (F1814).
sections.he:
**Settle Route Data (Settle Route Data)** — Application Type: Transactional.
ניתן להציג routes ב-SAP S/4HANA באמצעות אפליקציה זו, עם תכונות שונות מופעלות על מנת לעדכן את ה-route. ניתן להציג את מידע ה-route וה-settlement המלא באפליקציה, עם process flow המוצג בין כל שלב. ניתן לבחור כל שלב ב-process flow לראיית מידע נוסף הקשור ל-route. התכונות הבאות זמינות:
▪ הוספת customer documents ל-route
▪ הקצאת inventory groups
▪ רישום payments
▪ זיהוי הבדלים בתהליך ה-check out וה-check in ותיקונם
▪ זיהוי ושינוי מוצרים שנטענו ופורקו במהלך stops
▪ בדיקה אם tolerances חרגו באמצעות tolerance groups
▪ settle של routes ב-foreground או תזמון ברקע (background)
ניווט לאפליקציות קשורות שונות נתמך, כגון Outbound Delivery (S/4HANA) (F0233A), Returns Delivery (S/4HANA) (F0234A), Manage Billing Documents (F0797), Material Documents Overview (F1077), ו-Sales Order (S/4HANA) (F1814).

sections.title: Settlement Document (Version 2)
sections.en: Settlement Document (Version 2) (F3658A) Application Type: Fact Sheet This centralized fact sheet app allows you to review all details related to any kind of settle- ment document in a single hub. The intention is to allow you to determine any related follow-up actions that need to be taken regarding settle- ment documents. A full graphical process flow is available for the settlement document under the Document Flow tab of the fact sheet. Account assignment for the document can be seen by selecting the Account Assignment menu option.
sections.he:
**Settlement Document (Version 2) (Settlement Document, גרסה 2)** — Application Type: Fact Sheet.
אפליקציית fact sheet מרכזית זו מאפשרת לסקור את כל הפרטים הקשורים לכל סוג של settlement document ב-hub יחיד. הכוונה היא לאפשר לקבוע כל פעולות follow-up קשורות שיש לנקוט בנוגע ל-settlement documents. process flow גרפי מלא זמין עבור ה-settlement document תחת לשונית Document Flow של ה-fact sheet. ניתן לראות את ה-account assignment עבור המסמך על ידי בחירת אפשרות התפריט Account Assignment.

sections.title: Track Sales Order Details
sections.en: Track Sales Order Details (F2981) Application Type: Transactional This app is extremely useful in understanding the flow and all the details for a specific sales order. There is an additional level of granularity, focused on a single sales order, compared with the related app, Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (F2577). The document flow is shown graphically in a tree structure, with additional features such Personal Copy for 3 Sales and Distribution 368 as the ability to view outstanding issues against the documents. Only the order, order without charge, and debit memo request document cate- gories are supported for this app. More details for each document can be shown by selecting the required node from the structure. A whole selection of related apps are supported through navigation from the Track Sales Order Details app, such as Sales Order Fulfillment Issues (Version 2) (F0029A), Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (F2577), and Predicted Delivery Delay (F3408). Tip In the SAP ERP 6.0 world, a document flow would only show the document number, sta- tus, and date of the related documents. The Track Sales Order Details app can show you the same, but in a graphical process flow, and in addition, the full details for all the related documents are visible at a click of a button together on a single screen. For this reason, it is recommended to use this app for tracking specific sales orders rather than the tradi- tional document flow attached to sales docu- ments in SAP GUI transactions. Transaction Code The equivalent transaction code in SAP GUI is Transaction VA03 (Display Sales Order).
sections.he:
**Track Sales Order Details (מעקב פרטי Sales Order)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו שימושית ביותר בהבנת הזרימה וכל הפרטים עבור sales order ספציפי. יש רמה נוספת של גרעיניות, ממוקדת ב-sales order יחיד, בהשוואה לאפליקציה הקשורה, Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (F2577). ה-document flow מוצג גרפית במבנה עץ, עם תכונות נוספות כגון היכולת לצפות בבעיות פתוחות מול המסמכים. רק קטגוריות המסמך order, order without charge, ו-debit memo request נתמכות עבור אפליקציה זו. ניתן להציג פרטים נוספים עבור כל מסמך על ידי בחירת ה-node הנדרש מהמבנה.
מבחר שלם של אפליקציות קשורות נתמכות דרך ניווט מאפליקציית Track Sales Order Details, כגון Sales Order Fulfillment Issues (Version 2) (F0029A), Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (F2577), ו-Predicted Delivery Delay (F3408).
**טיפ:** בעולם SAP ERP 6.0, document flow היה מציג רק את document number, status, ו-date של המסמכים הקשורים. אפליקציית Track Sales Order Details יכולה להציג את אותו דבר, אך ב-process flow גרפי, ובנוסף, הפרטים המלאים עבור כל המסמכים הקשורים נראים בלחיצת כפתור יחד במסך יחיד. מסיבה זו, מומלץ להשתמש באפליקציה זו למעקב אחר sales orders ספציפיים במקום ה-document flow המסורתי המצורף ל-sales documents ב-transactions של SAP GUI.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction code המקביל ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction VA03 (Display Sales Order).

sections.title: Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA)
sections.en: Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (F2577) Application Type: Analytical This very useful app provides a centralized hub where you can trace the progress of a specific sales order from a list of sales orders generated from filter options such as sales document, sold- to party, customer reference, requested delivery date, overall status, and document date. The ensuing list shows the sales documents with their process phases (such as in order, in deliv- ery, in invoice, or in accounting), displayed as a single text, but also as a series of ticks or excla- mation marks against each phase. Clicking a spe- cific line will take you to the details for that doc- ument to show any outstanding issues, billing or payment details, attachments, business part- ners involved in the document, and the graphi- cal display of the process flow. Navigation to the related Track Sales Order Details app (F2981) is supported in order to view much more information related to the sales order and its related documents. Transaction Code The equivalent transaction code in SAP GUI is Transaction VA03 (Display Sales Order).
sections.he:
**Track Sales Orders (S/4HANA) (מעקב Sales Orders, S/4HANA)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה שימושית מאוד זו מספקת hub מרכזי שבו ניתן לעקוב אחר התקדמות של sales order ספציפי מרשימת sales orders שנוצרה מאפשרויות סינון כגון sales document, sold-to party, customer reference, requested delivery date, overall status, ו-document date. הרשימה הנובעת מציגה את ה-sales documents עם שלבי התהליך שלהם (כגון in order, in delivery, in invoice, או in accounting), המוצגים כטקסט יחיד, אך גם כסדרה של ticks או סימני קריאה מול כל שלב. לחיצה על שורה ספציפית תוביל לפרטים עבור אותו מסמך להצגת כל בעיות פתוחות, פרטי billing או payment, attachments, business partners המעורבים במסמך, וההצגה הגרפית של ה-process flow.
ניווט לאפליקציית Track Sales Order Details (F2981) הקשורה נתמך על מנת לצפות במידע רב יותר הקשור ל-sales order ולמסמכים הקשורים שלו.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction code המקביל ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction VA03 (Display Sales Order).

sections.title: Trade Compliance Document
sections.en: Trade Compliance Document (F5977) Application Type: Fact Sheet As with all fact sheet apps, the enterprise search in the SAP Fiori launchpad can be used to open this app. Filters in the dropdown list in enter- prise search, next to the search input fields, can be used to narrow down your search parame- ters. Filters such as sales orders, sales contracts, purchase orders, company code, plant, and part- ner country and region are available in the enterprise search filter bar. Once a document is selected and the fact sheet app is opened, all information related to the trade compliance document can be viewed in one place, including document number, overall status, legal control status, embargo status, SAP Watch List Screen- ing status, and business partners. Navigation to the related Manage Documents – Trade Compliance app (F2826) is supported. ©
sections.he:
**Trade Compliance Document (Trade Compliance Document)** — Application Type: Fact Sheet.
כמו בכל אפליקציות ה-fact sheet, ניתן להשתמש ב-enterprise search ב-SAP Fiori launchpad לפתיחת אפליקציה זו. מסננים ברשימת ה-dropdown ב-enterprise search, ליד שדות קלט החיפוש, ניתנים לשימוש לצמצום פרמטרי החיפוש שלך. מסננים כגון sales orders, sales contracts, purchase orders, company code, plant, ו-partner country ו-region זמינים ב-filter bar של ה-enterprise search. לאחר בחירת מסמך ופתיחת אפליקציית ה-fact sheet, ניתן לצפות בכל המידע הקשור למסמך ה-trade compliance במקום אחד, כולל document number, overall status, legal control status, embargo status, SAP Watch List Screening status, ו-business partners.
ניווט לאפליקציית Manage Documents – Trade Compliance (F2826) הקשורה נתמך.

sections.title: Advanced Shipping and Receiving Cockpit
sections.en: Advanced Shipping and Receiving Cockpit (F7366) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to monitor freight orders and loading/unloading points in the warehouse. The app is flexible enough to handle deliveries generated in extended warehouse management (EWM) and in inventory management. Multiple selection options to determine the data to dis- play are available, including freight order, ware- house number, loading/unloading point, ware- house door, warehouse door status, loading/ unloading completed, carrier, transportation planning on/at, execution status, and lifecycle status. You can click one of the listed freight orders to navigate to the related Web Dynpro app, Load or Unload Freight Orders (/SCMTMS/ ASR()).
sections.he:
**Advanced Shipping and Receiving Cockpit (קוקפיט Advanced Shipping and Receiving)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לנטר freight orders ו-loading/unloading points במחסן. האפליקציה גמישה מספיק לטפל ב-deliveries שנוצרו ב-extended warehouse management (EWM) וב-inventory management. אפשרויות בחירה מרובות לקביעת הנתונים להצגה זמינות, כולל freight order, warehouse number, loading/unloading point, warehouse door, warehouse door status, loading/unloading completed, carrier, transportation planning on/at, execution status, ו-lifecycle status. ניתן ללחוץ על אחד ה-freight orders המפורטים לניווט לאפליקציית ה-Web Dynpro הקשורה, Load or Unload Freight Orders (/SCMTMS/ASR()).

sections.title: Allocation – ALP
sections.en: Allocation – ALP (F2745) Application Type: Analytical This app provides KPIs in an analytical list page (ALP). The list of KPIs shows the weight, volume, and value of the transportation allocation. Each unit of measure can show total and average uti- lization. The KPIs are displayed in a chart, with options to change the type of chart displayed, and the data is displayed for the current and the previous month so that you can identify key trends. The data can be viewed by carrier, allow- ing you to identify the total weight, volume, and container utilization for each carrier.
sections.he:
**Allocation – ALP (Allocation – ALP)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מספקת KPIs ב-analytical list page (ALP). רשימת ה-KPIs מציגה את ה-weight, volume, ו-value של ה-transportation allocation. כל unit of measure יכול להציג utilization כולל וממוצע. ה-KPIs מוצגים ב-chart, עם אפשרויות לשנות את סוג ה-chart המוצג, והנתונים מוצגים עבור החודש הנוכחי והקודם כך שניתן לזהות מגמות מרכזיות. ניתן לצפות בנתונים לפי carrier, ומאפשר לזהות את ה-weight, volume, ו-container utilization הכוללים עבור כל carrier.

sections.title: Allocation Compliance
sections.en: Allocation Compliance (F2673) Application Type: Analytical This overview page offers an alternative view of the transport allocation in a single hub. The list of KPIs shows the weight, volume, and value of Personal Copy for 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management 370 the transportation allocation. The data is retrieved by selecting one of the following cards from the overview page: ▪ Tradelane Weight Load Analysis ▪ Tradelane Volume Load Analysis ▪ Tradelane Container Load Analysis ▪ Transportation Mode Category Analysis ▪ Overall Weight Utilization Distribution ▪ Overall Container Utilization Distribution Technically, this page retrieves data using CDS view C_TranspAllocComplianceQ.
sections.he:
**Allocation Compliance (Allocation Compliance)** — Application Type: Analytical.
overview page זה מציע תצוגה חלופית של ה-transport allocation ב-hub יחיד. רשימת ה-KPIs מציגה את ה-weight, volume, ו-value של ה-transportation allocation. הנתונים נמשכים על ידי בחירת אחד ה-cards הבאים מה-overview page:
▪ Tradelane Weight Load Analysis
▪ Tradelane Volume Load Analysis
▪ Tradelane Container Load Analysis
▪ Transportation Mode Category Analysis
▪ Overall Weight Utilization Distribution
▪ Overall Container Utilization Distribution
טכנית, עמוד זה מאחזר נתונים באמצעות CDS view C_TranspAllocComplianceQ.

sections.title: Analyze Delivery Logs
sections.en: Analyze Delivery Logs (F0870A) Application Type: Transactional Collective background jobs for the creation of deliveries (outbound and inbound) can be ana- lyzed using this app. Selection options such as log number, created by, created on, shipping point, and log status are available. A list of back- ground jobs and log numbers is displayed in a table format. Clicking an entry will take you to a more detailed screen, on which you can see the details of the collected messages and the full list of delivery numbers.
sections.he:
**Analyze Delivery Logs (ניתוח יומני משלוח)** — Application Type: Transactional.
ניתן לנתח collective background jobs ליצירת deliveries (outbound ו-inbound) באמצעות אפליקציה זו. אפשרויות בחירה כגון log number, created by, created on, shipping point, ו-log status זמינות. רשימה של background jobs ו-log numbers מוצגת בפורמט table. לחיצה על רשומה תוביל למסך מפורט יותר, שבו ניתן לראות את פרטי ההודעות שנאספו ואת הרשימה המלאה של מספרי ה-delivery.

sections.title: Analyze Stock in Date Range
sections.en: Analyze Stock in Date Range (F6185) Application Type: Transactional This app can be used by inventory managers to analyze goods movements for specific materials or ranges of materials within a given date range. There are standard SAP use cases provided for filters, as follows: ▪ Standard: Displays the most vital stock quan- tity and value fields for the material ▪ Stock quantity: Displays net receipt quantity and net goods issue quantity ▪ Supplier consignment stock: Displays the supplier consignment (K) special stock type It’s also possible to create your own filter view. The results are organized into two separate page views: the Main page and the Detail page. The Main page displays a list of all the materials with stock counts and an option to navigate directly to the detail page. The Detail page displays a microchart showing all relevant stock details for the material selected. You can also define background jobs for inven- tory movement from this app. Tip Authorizations are key for this app and could lead to zeros being displayed for certain attri- butes in the results table. These attributes can be hidden, or the authorizations can be ana- lyzed to assess what is missing from the user record.
sections.he:
**Analyze Stock in Date Range (ניתוח מלאי בטווח תאריכים)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו יכולה לשמש את inventory managers לניתוח goods movements עבור materials ספציפיים או טווחי materials בתוך טווח תאריכים נתון. קיימים use cases סטנדרטיים של SAP המסופקים עבור מסננים, כדלקמן:
▪ Standard: מציג את שדות ה-stock quantity וה-value החיוניים ביותר עבור ה-material.
▪ Stock quantity: מציג net receipt quantity ו-net goods issue quantity.
▪ Supplier consignment stock: מציג את סוג ה-special stock של supplier consignment (K).
ניתן גם ליצור תצוגת מסנן משלך. התוצאות מאורגנות לשתי תצוגות עמוד נפרדות: עמוד ה-Main ועמוד ה-Detail. עמוד ה-Main מציג רשימה של כל ה-materials עם stock counts ואפשרות לנווט ישירות לעמוד ה-detail. עמוד ה-Detail מציג microchart המציג את כל פרטי ה-stock הרלוונטיים עבור ה-material הנבחר. ניתן גם להגדיר background jobs עבור inventory movement מאפליקציה זו.
**טיפ:** Authorizations הם מפתח לאפליקציה זו ועלולים להוביל להצגת אפסים עבור attributes מסוימים בטבלת התוצאות. ניתן להסתיר attributes אלה, או שניתן לנתח את ה-authorizations להערכת מה חסר מרשומת המשתמש.

sections.title: Analyze Warehouse Task
sections.en: Analyze Warehouse Task (F5123) Application Type: Analytical This app can be used to analyze all tasks assigned as part of extended warehouse man- agement (EWM). These tasks include picks, put- aways, internal goods movements, posting changes, goods receipt postings, and goods issue postings. You can create warehouse tasks with reference to a warehouse request. You can also create warehouse tasks without a reference—for example, for internal goods movements.
sections.he:
**Analyze Warehouse Task (ניתוח Warehouse Task)** — Application Type: Analytical.
ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו לניתוח כל ה-tasks המוקצים כחלק מ-extended warehouse management (EWM). tasks אלה כוללים picks, putaways, internal goods movements, posting changes, goods receipt postings, ו-goods issue postings. ניתן ליצור warehouse tasks בהפניה ל-warehouse request. ניתן גם ליצור warehouse tasks ללא reference — לדוגמה, עבור internal goods movements.

sections.title: Analyzer Warehouse Order
sections.en: Analyzer Warehouse Order (F5122) Application Type: Analytical Warehouse tasks have specific KPIs assigned to them, and this app allows you to view these KPIs in more detail. Navigation to drilldown reports is supported. Various selection filters are avail- able such as warehouse order queue, warehouse, warehouse order, activity area, and warehouse © 371 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management order status. The results are displayed in a table, with variants available for configuration. Each warehouse order has a separate row, and users can see the status, activity area, queue, ware- house order creation rule, and process type. This analytical overview app is relevant for the ware- house clerk role in SAP Fiori and was introduced in SAP S/4HANA 2021.
sections.he:
**Analyzer Warehouse Order (Analyzer Warehouse Order)** — Application Type: Analytical.
ל-warehouse tasks יש KPIs ספציפיים המוקצים להם, ואפליקציה זו מאפשרת לצפות ב-KPIs אלה בפירוט רב יותר. ניווט ל-drilldown reports נתמך. מסנני בחירה שונים זמינים כגון warehouse order queue, warehouse, warehouse order, activity area, ו-warehouse order status. התוצאות מוצגות ב-table, עם variants זמינים ל-configuration. לכל warehouse order יש שורה נפרדת, ומשתמשים יכולים לראות את ה-status, activity area, queue, warehouse order creation rule, ו-process type. אפליקציית סקירה אנליטית זו רלוונטית לתפקיד ה-warehouse clerk ב-SAP Fiori והוצגה ב-SAP S/4HANA 2021.

sections.title: Application Log for Just-In-Time Supply to Customer
sections.en: Application Log for Just-In-Time Supply to Customer (F4961) Application Type: Transactional Just-in-time (JIT) call processing jobs create application logs in SAP. This app can be used by shipping specialists to identify issues to resolve in a centralized hub. Multiple options for select- ing the data to display are available, including severity, from and to dates, category, subcate- gory, and external reference. Tip When creating a JIT log, add a sales order ID as an external reference. As a result, you can fil- ter all logs related to that sales order.
sections.he:
**Application Log for Just-In-Time Supply to Customer (יומן יישום עבור JIT Supply ללקוח)** — Application Type: Transactional.
jobs של עיבוד just-in-time (JIT) call יוצרים application logs ב-SAP. ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו על ידי shipping specialists לזיהוי בעיות לפתרון ב-hub מרכזי. אפשרויות מרובות לבחירת הנתונים להצגה זמינות, כולל severity, תאריכי from ו-to, category, subcategory, ו-external reference.
**טיפ:** בעת יצירת JIT log, הוסף sales order ID כ-external reference. כתוצאה, ניתן לסנן את כל ה-logs הקשורים לאותו sales order.

sections.title: Application Logs for Manufacturing Logistics
sections.en: Application Logs for Manufacturing Logistics (F5189) Application Type: Transactional Manufacturing logistics processes create pro- cessing jobs with application logs in SAP. This app can be used by warehouse clerks to identify issues to resolve in a centralized hub. Multiple options for selecting the data to display are available, including severity, from and to dates, category, subcategory, and external reference. The data is displayed in a table along with the description of the subcategory it refers to, such as logistical reevaluation, route, warehouse task, warehouse request, warehouse order, or tour.
sections.he:
**Application Logs for Manufacturing Logistics (יומני יישום עבור Manufacturing Logistics)** — Application Type: Transactional.
תהליכי manufacturing logistics יוצרים processing jobs עם application logs ב-SAP. ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו על ידי warehouse clerks לזיהוי בעיות לפתרון ב-hub מרכזי. אפשרויות מרובות לבחירת הנתונים להצגה זמינות, כולל severity, תאריכי from ו-to, category, subcategory, ו-external reference. הנתונים מוצגים ב-table יחד עם תיאור ה-subcategory שאליו הם מתייחסים, כגון logistical reevaluation, route, warehouse task, warehouse request, warehouse order, או tour.

sections.title: Block Bulk Bins from Putaway
sections.en: Block Bulk Bins from Putaway (F5485) Application Type: Transactional This app allows warehouse clerks to block the putaway of goods into storage bins in the bulk area. This exercise can be done in the fore- ground (immediate) or in the background as a scheduled job. With the app, scheduled jobs can be created as copies of existing jobs. In addition, jobs can be viewed, monitored, or canceled. Mul- tiple selection options are available for the cre- ation of the job, including template selection parameters such as job template (select from dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as scheduling options such as the Start Immedi- ately flag, recurrence pattern (single run or recurring), and start date and time. Parameter options related to the putaway task are avail- able.
sections.he:
**Block Bulk Bins from Putaway (חסימת Bulk Bins מ-Putaway)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ל-warehouse clerks לחסום את ה-putaway של goods לתוך storage bins באזור ה-bulk. ניתן לבצע תרגיל זה ב-foreground (מיידי) או ברקע כ-scheduled job. בעזרת האפליקציה, ניתן ליצור scheduled jobs כעותקים של jobs קיימים. בנוסף, ניתן לצפות, לנטר, או לבטל jobs. אפשרויות בחירה מרובות זמינות ליצירת ה-job, כולל פרמטרי template selection כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן אפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. אפשרויות פרמטר הקשורות ל-putaway task זמינות.

sections.title: Business Share
sections.en: Business Share (F2674) Application Type: Analytical This overview page related to transportation management (TM) in SAP S/4HANA allows man- agers to get real-time insight into the KPIs required to manage transportation of products by carriers to customers. The intention is to pro- vide a centralized hub for all insight into a busi- ness’s dealings with carriers. The overview page is organized into the following cards, which pro- vide individual KPIs for analysis: ▪ Weight Fulfillment Ratio This card shows how carriers have performed against their allotted weight for transporta- tion (e.g., they may have shipped 151,250 kg out of a total allocation of 208,210 kg). This fulfillment ratio can also be shown as a per- centage. ▪ Volume Fulfillment Ratio This card shows how carriers have performed against their allotted volume for transporta- tion (e.g., they may have shipped 1000 m3 out of a total allocation of 2500 m3). This fulfill- ment ratio can also be shown as a percentage. Personal Copy for 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management 372 ▪ Road Fulfillment Ratio This card shows, in graphical format, the vol- ume of goods transported by road for the actual booked quantity against the target quantity. ▪ Sea Fulfillment Ratio This card shows, in graphical format, the vol- ume of goods transported by sea for the actual booked quantity against the target quantity. ▪ Air Fulfillment Ratio This card shows, in graphical format, the vol- ume of goods transported by air for the actual booked quantity against the target quantity. ▪ Trade Lane Fulfillment This card shows how each trade lane performs against its allotted share. The units can be weight or volume. You can navigate from the app to the Business Share – ALP app (F2746), where you can get ana- lytical information related to your carrier busi- ness.
sections.he:
**Business Share (Business Share)** — Application Type: Analytical.
overview page זה הקשור ל-transportation management (TM) ב-SAP S/4HANA מאפשר ל-managers לקבל תובנה בזמן אמת ל-KPIs הנדרשים לניהול transportation של מוצרים על ידי carriers ללקוחות. הכוונה היא לספק hub מרכזי לכל התובנה לגבי התקשרויות עסק עם carriers. ה-overview page מאורגן ל-cards הבאים, המספקים KPIs בודדים לניתוח:
▪ Weight Fulfillment Ratio — card זה מציג כיצד carriers ביצעו מול ה-weight המוקצה שלהם ל-transportation (לדוגמה, ייתכן ששלחו 151,250 kg מתוך allocation כולל של 208,210 kg). ניתן להציג fulfillment ratio זה גם כאחוז.
▪ Volume Fulfillment Ratio — card זה מציג כיצד carriers ביצעו מול ה-volume המוקצה שלהם ל-transportation (לדוגמה, ייתכן ששלחו 1000 m3 מתוך allocation כולל של 2500 m3). ניתן להציג fulfillment ratio זה גם כאחוז.
▪ Road Fulfillment Ratio — card זה מציג, בפורמט גרפי, את ה-volume של goods המובלים בכביש עבור ה-actual booked quantity מול ה-target quantity.
▪ Sea Fulfillment Ratio — card זה מציג, בפורמט גרפי, את ה-volume של goods המובלים בים עבור ה-actual booked quantity מול ה-target quantity.
▪ Air Fulfillment Ratio — card זה מציג, בפורמט גרפי, את ה-volume של goods המובלים באוויר עבור ה-actual booked quantity מול ה-target quantity.
▪ Trade Lane Fulfillment — card זה מציג כיצד כל trade lane מבצע מול ה-share המוקצה שלו. היחידות יכולות להיות weight או volume.
ניתן לנווט מהאפליקציה לאפליקציית Business Share – ALP (F2746), שבה ניתן לקבל מידע אנליטי הקשור לעסקי ה-carrier שלך.

sections.title: Business Share – ALP
sections.en: Business Share – ALP (F2746) Application Type: Analytical This very useful SAP Fiori app gives you a much more detailed level of information regarding carrier business. Information available in the Business Share app (F2674) can be displayed in this app as well, with graphical and table over- views for each category. Navigation between this app and related apps in the transportation management (TM) function are supported, such as Freight Booking Execution (F2677) and other freight-related apps.
sections.he:
**Business Share – ALP (Business Share – ALP)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציית SAP Fiori שימושית מאוד זו מעניקה רמה מפורטת הרבה יותר של מידע בנוגע לעסקי carrier. מידע הזמין באפליקציית Business Share (F2674) ניתן להצגה גם באפליקציה זו, עם סקירות גרפיות וטבלאיות עבור כל category. ניווט בין אפליקציה זו לאפליקציות קשורות בפונקציית ה-transportation management (TM) נתמך, כגון Freight Booking Execution (F2677) ואפליקציות freight אחרות.

sections.title: Change Inbound Delivery
sections.en: Change Inbound Delivery (F1706) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can change an inbound deliv- ery to carry out tasks such as changing the deliv- ery quantity, deleting items, entering batch information, creating or changing handling units, and posting goods receipt. It is also possi- ble to upload and delete attachments, such as photographs or documents in various formats. You can navigate to the related Create Inbound Delivery (F1705) and Process Warehouse Tasks (F4595) apps. Tip When a delivery arrives at the goods-in loca- tion, use this app to cross-reference the deliv- ery note from the driver against the expected delivery and make changes in SAP accordingly. It’s also possible to add items to an open inbound delivery, in case the delivery from the driver contains items belonging to a different purchase order. Transaction Code The associated transaction in SAP GUI is Transaction VL32N (Change Inbound Deliv- ery).
sections.he:
**Change Inbound Delivery (שינוי Inbound Delivery)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן לשנות inbound delivery לביצוע משימות כגון שינוי ה-delivery quantity, מחיקת items, הזנת מידע batch, יצירה או שינוי של handling units, ורישום goods receipt. ניתן גם להעלות ולמחוק attachments, כגון תצלומים או מסמכים בפורמטים שונים.
ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות הקשורות Create Inbound Delivery (F1705) ו-Process Warehouse Tasks (F4595).
**טיפ:** כאשר delivery מגיע ל-goods-in location, השתמש באפליקציה זו ל-cross-reference של ה-delivery note מהנהג מול ה-delivery הצפוי ובצע שינויים ב-SAP בהתאם. ניתן גם להוסיף items ל-inbound delivery פתוח, במקרה שה-delivery מהנהג מכיל items השייכים ל-purchase order אחר.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction המשויך ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction VL32N (Change Inbound Delivery).

sections.title: Change Inbound Delivery – Production
sections.en: Change Inbound Delivery – Production (F5162) Application Type: Transactional Inbound deliveries can be from external sources but also can be related to items arriving in the warehouse location from the production lines. This app allows you to compare the inbound delivery in SAP with the physical goods arriving from production. The available tasks include changing the delivery quantity, deleting deliv- ery items, entering batch information, creating or changing handling units, and posting or reversing goods receipts. It is also possible to upload and delete attachments, such as photo- graphs or documents in various formats. You can navigate to the related Change Inbound Delivery (F1706) and Process Warehouse Tasks (F4595) apps. © 373 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management
sections.he:
**Change Inbound Delivery – Production (שינוי Inbound Delivery – Production)** — Application Type: Transactional.
inbound deliveries יכולים להיות ממקורות חיצוניים אך יכולים גם להיות קשורים ל-items המגיעים ל-warehouse location מקווי הייצור. אפליקציה זו מאפשרת להשוות את ה-inbound delivery ב-SAP מול ה-goods הפיזיים המגיעים מהייצור. המשימות הזמינות כוללות שינוי ה-delivery quantity, מחיקת delivery items, הזנת מידע batch, יצירה או שינוי של handling units, ורישום או ביטול של goods receipts. ניתן גם להעלות ולמחוק attachments, כגון תצלומים או מסמכים בפורמטים שונים.
ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות הקשורות Change Inbound Delivery (F1706) ו-Process Warehouse Tasks (F4595).

sections.title: Check-Out/In Differences
sections.en: Check-Out/In Differences (F4741) Application Type: Transactional Routes have planned quantities that can be tracked against actual quantities by using this app. The app tracks planned and actual check-out quantities for the route against expected and actual check-in quantities. This is useful for ana- lyzing the efficiency of the execution of the route. You can navigate to the related Outbound Deliv- ery (F0233A), Return Delivery (F1996), and Track Sales Order Details (F2981) apps.
sections.he:
**Check-Out/In Differences (הבדלי Check-Out/In)** — Application Type: Transactional.
ל-routes יש planned quantities שניתן לעקוב אחריהם מול actual quantities באמצעות אפליקציה זו. האפליקציה עוקבת אחר planned ו-actual check-out quantities עבור ה-route מול expected ו-actual check-in quantities. הדבר שימושי לניתוח יעילות ביצוע ה-route.
ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות הקשורות Outbound Delivery (F0233A), Return Delivery (F1996), ו-Track Sales Order Details (F2981).

sections.title: Classify Products – Commodity Codes for Transportation
sections.en: Classify Products – Commodity Codes for Transportation (F7151) Application Type: Transactional As part of the SAP S/4HANA for international trade functionality, this app can be used to clas- sify materials to a specific commodity code, using a specific numbering scheme. From within the search features of the app, you can find unclassified products based on product number, product description, material type, material group, and division. The app presents a list of products based upon the selection criteria used, and you can select single or multiple entries to classify them. Commodity code classi- fications can be set using validity dates, and remarks can be added during the process.
sections.he:
**Classify Products – Commodity Codes for Transportation (סיווג מוצרים – Commodity Codes ל-Transportation)** — Application Type: Transactional.
כחלק מפונקציונליות SAP S/4HANA for international trade, ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו לסיווג materials ל-commodity code ספציפי, באמצעות numbering scheme ספציפי. מתוך תכונות החיפוש של האפליקציה, ניתן למצוא מוצרים לא מסווגים על בסיס product number, product description, material type, material group, ו-division. האפליקציה מציגה רשימת מוצרים על בסיס קריטריוני הבחירה בשימוש, וניתן לבחור רשומות בודדות או מרובות לסיווגן. ניתן להגדיר commodity code classifications באמצעות תאריכי validity, וניתן להוסיף הערות במהלך התהליך.

sections.title: Configure Activity Attributes
sections.en: Configure Activity Attributes (F6439) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can use business process scheduling (BPS) flexibly to configure the dura- tions of logistics activities and define the neces- sary working times for scheduling them. These durations and working times are based on attri- butes in the sales documents. Available activi- ties in the app include the following: ▪ Creation of accesses that contain characteris- tic value combinations based on scheduling activity ▪ Assigning values to each characteristic value combination ▪ Changing the sequencing priority of the access ▪ Changing the status of the accesses to one of the available statuses: active, inactive, or obsolete ▪ Controlling the use of characteristic value combinations based on authorization groups Tip After manually changing any activity attri- butes, it is recommended to run rescheduling for the sales documents in question.
sections.he:
**Configure Activity Attributes (הגדרת Activity Attributes)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן להשתמש ב-business process scheduling (BPS) בגמישות להגדרת ה-durations של פעילויות logistics ולהגדיר את ה-working times הנחוצים לתזמונן. durations ו-working times אלה מבוססים על attributes ב-sales documents. פעילויות זמינות באפליקציה כוללות את הבאים:
▪ יצירת accesses המכילים characteristic value combinations על בסיס scheduling activity
▪ הקצאת ערכים לכל characteristic value combination
▪ שינוי עדיפות ה-sequencing של ה-access
▪ שינוי ה-status של ה-accesses לאחד מ-statuses הזמינים: active, inactive, או obsolete
▪ בקרת השימוש ב-characteristic value combinations על בסיס authorization groups
**טיפ:** לאחר שינוי ידני של activity attributes כלשהם, מומלץ להריץ rescheduling עבור ה-sales documents הנדונים.

sections.title: Configure Alternative Determination
sections.en: Configure Alternative Determination (F5354) Application Type: Transactional As a part of the advanced available-to-promise (ATP) solution, this app allows you to define alternative determinations for sales order requirements. It is possible to define rating attri- butes and hard constraints within the app. Tem- plates can also be defined that contain precon- figured alternative determinations for confirming requirements fully, on time, or ear- lier than on time but with as large a quantity as is possible. Rating attributes to drive the alterna- tive determination, such as minimum delay, minimum number of plants, and minimum number of storage locations, can be configured, as can hard constraints to limit the alternative determination, such as maximum confirma- tion ratio.
sections.he:
**Configure Alternative Determination (הגדרת Alternative Determination)** — Application Type: Transactional.
כחלק מפתרון ה-advanced available-to-promise (ATP), אפליקציה זו מאפשרת להגדיר alternative determinations עבור דרישות sales order. ניתן להגדיר rating attributes ו-hard constraints בתוך האפליקציה. ניתן גם להגדיר templates המכילים alternative determinations מוגדרים-מראש לאישור דרישות במלואן, בזמן, או מוקדם מהזמן אך עם כמות גדולה ככל האפשר. ניתן להגדיר rating attributes להנעת ה-alternative determination, כגון minimum delay, minimum number of plants, ו-minimum number of storage locations, וכן hard constraints להגבלת ה-alternative determination, כגון maximum confirmation ratio.

sections.title: Configure Supply Protection
sections.en: Configure Supply Protection (F4569) Application Type: Transactional This useful app can be used to protect the quan- tities of a given material in a plant against other demand. There are two approaches to providing this protection: Personal Copy for 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management 374 ▪ Horizontal protection: Complete groups are protected against each other. ▪ Vertical protection: Priority is assigned to groups, so with vertical protection, every group is only protected against demands originating from groups with a lower priority. Quantities that are protected are defined by a combination of a material and a plant, with other characteristics available as well. Supply protec- tion objects also can be defined, such as sales orders, stock transport orders, and so on. In addi- tion, protection can be defined by validity dates. Supply protection integrates natively with back- order processing and product allocation.
sections.he:
**Configure Supply Protection (הגדרת Supply Protection)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה שימושית זו יכולה לשמש להגנה על הכמויות של material נתון ב-plant מול demand אחר. קיימות שתי גישות למתן הגנה זו:
▪ Horizontal protection: קבוצות שלמות מוגנות זו מול זו.
▪ Vertical protection: עדיפות מוקצית לקבוצות, כך שעם vertical protection, כל קבוצה מוגנת רק מול demands הנובעים מקבוצות בעלות עדיפות נמוכה יותר.
כמויות המוגנות מוגדרות על ידי שילוב של material ו-plant, עם characteristics אחרים זמינים גם. ניתן גם להגדיר supply protection objects, כגון sales orders, stock transport orders, וכן הלאה. בנוסף, ניתן להגדיר הגנה לפי תאריכי validity. supply protection משתלב באופן native עם backorder processing ו-product allocation.

sections.title: Confirm Freight Orders
sections.en: Confirm Freight Orders (F5694) Application Type: Transactional This app can be used to respond to freight orders sent by the shipper. In this app, you can review freight orders that require confirmation and view their details, such as source and desti- nation, transportation, cargo, dangerous goods, driver, stops, notes, and attachments. You can also update the freight order with the driver and registration, and initiate changes to the con- firmed end date/time, price limit, or currency.
sections.he:
**Confirm Freight Orders (אישור Freight Orders)** — Application Type: Transactional.
ניתן להשתמש באפליקציה זו להגיב ל-freight orders שנשלחו על ידי ה-shipper. באפליקציה זו, ניתן לסקור freight orders הדורשים אישור ולצפות בפרטיהם, כגון source ו-destination, transportation, cargo, dangerous goods, driver, stops, notes, ו-attachments. ניתן גם לעדכן את ה-freight order עם ה-driver וה-registration, וליזום שינויים ב-confirmed end date/time, price limit, או currency.

sections.title: Count Physical Inventory
sections.en: Count Physical Inventory (F3340) Application Type: Transactional Many physical inventory counting processes are still carried out using paper. With this app, you can count the results of the physical inventory documents after the warehouse operator has manually recorded the count results on the physical inventory documents. The app allows you to make various changes to physical inven- tory documents, such as activating/deactivating the documents, printing documents and defin- ing the layout of the printouts, assigning prod- ucts and handling units as well as serial num- bers, and assigning a count reference to the items.
sections.he:
**Count Physical Inventory (ספירת Physical Inventory)** — Application Type: Transactional.
תהליכי ספירת physical inventory רבים עדיין מבוצעים באמצעות נייר. בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן לספור את תוצאות ה-physical inventory documents לאחר שמפעיל המחסן רשם ידנית את תוצאות הספירה על ה-physical inventory documents. האפליקציה מאפשרת לבצע שינויים שונים ל-physical inventory documents, כגון הפעלה/השבתה של המסמכים, הדפסת מסמכים והגדרת הפריסה של ההדפסות, הקצאת מוצרים ו-handling units וכן serial numbers, והקצאת count reference ל-items.

sections.title: Create Inbound Delivery
sections.en: Create Inbound Delivery (F1705) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can create an inbound deliv- ery to carry out tasks such as adding the delivery quantity, entering batch information, creating handling units, and posting goods receipt. It is also possible to upload attachments, such as photographs or documents in various formats. Navigation to the related Change Inbound Deliv- ery app (F1706) is supported. Transaction Code The associated transaction in SAP GUI is Transaction VL31N (Create Inbound Delivery).
sections.he:
**Create Inbound Delivery (יצירת Inbound Delivery)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן ליצור inbound delivery לביצוע משימות כגון הוספת ה-delivery quantity, הזנת מידע batch, יצירת handling units, ורישום goods receipt. ניתן גם להעלות attachments, כגון תצלומים או מסמכים בפורמטים שונים.
ניווט לאפליקציית Change Inbound Delivery (F1706) הקשורה נתמך.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction המשויך ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction VL31N (Create Inbound Delivery).

sections.title: Create JIT Delivery Schedule (In Background)
sections.en: Create JIT Delivery Schedule (In Background) (F5001) Application Type: Transactional With this app, just-in-time (JIT) delivery sched- ules can be created with reference to scheduling agreements as a background job. The schedule is based on JIT calls received from customers. Mul- tiple selection options are available for the cre- ation of the job, including template selection parameters such as job template (select from dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as scheduling options such as the Start Immedi- ately flag, recurrence pattern (single run or recurring), and start date and time. Parameter options related to the JIT delivery schedule include till specific date, till date, call compo- nents, external status, plant, and sold-to party.
sections.he:
**Create JIT Delivery Schedule (In Background) (יצירת JIT Delivery Schedule, ברקע)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן ליצור just-in-time (JIT) delivery schedules בהפניה ל-scheduling agreements כ-background job. ה-schedule מבוסס על JIT calls שהתקבלו מלקוחות. אפשרויות בחירה מרובות זמינות ליצירת ה-job, כולל פרמטרי template selection כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן אפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. אפשרויות פרמטר הקשורות ל-JIT delivery schedule כוללות till specific date, till date, call components, external status, plant, ו-sold-to party.

sections.title: Create Outbound Deliveries from Sequenced JIT Calls
sections.en: Create Outbound Deliveries from Sequenced JIT Calls (F3897) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can create outbound deliver- ies from sequenced just-in-time (JIT) calls on a package unit, according to specific shipping © 375 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management points. It is possible to split the delivery docu- ment based upon the criteria maintained in the Manage JIT Customer Data app (F3011). Selection criteria for finding package groups include the just-in-sequence (JIS) packaging unit ID. Often used in the automotive industry, JIS comes into play when parts need to arrive not only just in time, but also in the correct sequence required for the efficient operation of the production line. Other selection criteria include component group material, ship-to party, unloading point, shipping point, requirement date and time, planned shipping date and time, and planned delivery date. From the list of package groups displayed, you can create outbound deliveries or view logs.
sections.he:
**Create Outbound Deliveries from Sequenced JIT Calls (יצירת Outbound Deliveries מ-Sequenced JIT Calls)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן ליצור outbound deliveries מ-sequenced just-in-time (JIT) calls על package unit, על פי shipping points ספציפיים. ניתן לפצל את מסמך ה-delivery על בסיס הקריטריונים המתוחזקים באפליקציית Manage JIT Customer Data (F3011). קריטריוני בחירה למציאת package groups כוללים את ה-just-in-sequence (JIS) packaging unit ID. בשימוש לעיתים קרובות בתעשיית הרכב, JIS נכנס לתמונה כאשר חלקים צריכים להגיע לא רק just in time, אלא גם ב-sequence הנכון הנדרש לתפעול היעיל של קו הייצור. קריטריוני בחירה אחרים כוללים component group material, ship-to party, unloading point, shipping point, requirement date and time, planned shipping date and time, ו-planned delivery date. מרשימת ה-package groups המוצגת, ניתן ליצור outbound deliveries או לצפות ב-logs.

sections.title: Create Outbound Deliveries from Summarized JIT Calls
sections.en: Create Outbound Deliveries from Summarized JIT Calls (F3922) Application Type: Transactional With this app, you can create outbound deliver- ies from summarized just-in-time (JIT) calls on component groups. Selection criteria for finding package groups include ship-to party, shipping point, planned creation date, delivery date and time, planned goods issue date and time, unloading point, external JIT call number, and requirement date and time. From the list of package groups displayed, you can create out- bound deliveries or view logs.
sections.he:
**Create Outbound Deliveries from Summarized JIT Calls (יצירת Outbound Deliveries מ-Summarized JIT Calls)** — Application Type: Transactional.
בעזרת אפליקציה זו, ניתן ליצור outbound deliveries מ-summarized just-in-time (JIT) calls על component groups. קריטריוני בחירה למציאת package groups כוללים ship-to party, shipping point, planned creation date, delivery date and time, planned goods issue date and time, unloading point, external JIT call number, ו-requirement date and time. מרשימת ה-package groups המוצגת, ניתן ליצור outbound deliveries או לצפות ב-logs.

sections.title: Create Physical Inventory Documents
sections.en: Create Physical Inventory Documents (F3197) Application Type: Transactional Inventory managers can use this app to create physical inventory documents for materials or groups of materials. This is part of the cycle count preparation, and the app assists with find- ing materials to be counted. Selection options for filtering include the plant, storage location, and not-counted-since date. The list of materials in the table is sorted by stock type (unrestricted stock, blocked stock, quality inspection stock, etc.). There are options to export the data to a spreadsheet or to attach documents. Transaction Code The associated transaction in SAP GUI is Transaction MI01 (Create Physical Inventory Document).
sections.he:
**Create Physical Inventory Documents (יצירת Physical Inventory Documents)** — Application Type: Transactional.
inventory managers יכולים להשתמש באפליקציה זו ליצירת physical inventory documents עבור materials או קבוצות של materials. הדבר הוא חלק מהכנת ה-cycle count, והאפליקציה מסייעת במציאת materials לספירה. אפשרויות בחירה לסינון כוללות את ה-plant, storage location, ו-not-counted-since date. רשימת ה-materials ב-table ממוינת לפי stock type (unrestricted stock, blocked stock, quality inspection stock, וכו'). קיימות אפשרויות לייצא את הנתונים ל-spreadsheet או לצרף מסמכים.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction המשויך ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction MI01 (Create Physical Inventory Document).

sections.title: Display Freight Quotations
sections.en: Display Freight Quotations (F5553) Application Type: Transactional Accepting freight requests for quotation (RFQs) creates freight quotations in SAP to send to the shipper. These quotations can be viewed using this app. The app displays all the freight quota- tions that have been awarded or rejected by the shipper as well as those that are still in pending status. You can view more information for the freight quotation as well, such as its source, des- tination transportation, cargo, dangerous goods, transportation stops, notes, and attachments.
sections.he:
**Display Freight Quotations (הצגת Freight Quotations)** — Application Type: Transactional.
קבלת freight requests for quotation (RFQs) יוצרת freight quotations ב-SAP לשליחה ל-shipper. ניתן לצפות ב-quotations אלה באמצעות אפליקציה זו. האפליקציה מציגה את כל ה-freight quotations שזכו או נדחו על ידי ה-shipper וכן אלה שעדיין ב-status pending. ניתן לצפות במידע נוסף עבור ה-freight quotation גם, כגון ה-source, destination transportation, cargo, dangerous goods, transportation stops, notes, ו-attachments.

sections.title: Display Serial Numbers
sections.en: Display Serial Numbers (F5147) Application Type: Analytical Employees such as warehouse clerks and inven- tory managers can use this app to display a list of serial numbers associated with a specific material. The list displayed is fully up to date according to the last goods movement for the serial number. Frequently, this app is accessed from the related Stock – Single Material (F1076) and Stock – Multiple Materials (F1595) apps. Transaction Code The associated transaction in SAP GUI is Transaction IQ09 (Display Material Serial Number). Personal Copy for 4 Inventory and Warehouse Management 376
sections.he:
**Display Serial Numbers (הצגת Serial Numbers)** — Application Type: Analytical.
עובדים כגון warehouse clerks ו-inventory managers יכולים להשתמש באפליקציה זו להצגת רשימה של serial numbers המשויכים ל-material ספציפי. הרשימה המוצגת מעודכנת לחלוטין על פי ה-goods movement האחרון עבור ה-serial number. לעיתים קרובות, ניגשים לאפליקציה זו מאפליקציות Stock – Single Material (F1076) ו-Stock – Multiple Materials (F1595) הקשורות.
**Transaction Code:** ה-transaction המשויך ב-SAP GUI הוא Transaction IQ09 (Display Material Serial Number).

sections.title: Expected Goods Receipt
sections.en: Expected Goods Receipt (F3298) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create background jobs for the transfer of expected goods receipts for purchase orders and production orders to extended warehouse management (EWM). You also can view the log for all jobs and cancel or restart jobs. Multiple selection options are avail- able for the creation of a job, including template selection parameters such as job template (select from dropdown list) and job name (free text), as well as scheduling options such as the Start Immediately flag, recurrence pattern (sin- gle run or recurring), and start date and time. Parameter options related to the just-in-time (JIT) delivery schedule include the warehouse number, selection start date, selection end date, supplier, purchasing document type, confirma- tion control, material, purchasing document, production order type, and production order.
sections.he:
**Expected Goods Receipt (Expected Goods Receipt)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור background jobs להעברת expected goods receipts עבור purchase orders ו-production orders ל-extended warehouse management (EWM). ניתן גם לצפות ב-log עבור כל ה-jobs ולבטל או להפעיל מחדש jobs. אפשרויות בחירה מרובות זמינות ליצירת job, כולל פרמטרי template selection כגון job template (בחירה מרשימת dropdown) ו-job name (טקסט חופשי), וכן אפשרויות scheduling כגון דגל Start Immediately, recurrence pattern (single run או recurring), ו-start date and time. אפשרויות פרמטר כוללות warehouse number, selection start date, selection end date, supplier, purchasing document type, confirmation control, material, purchasing document, production order type, ו-production order.

sections.title: Explain Scheduling Results
sections.en: Explain Scheduling Results (F4976) Application Type: Transactional This app is part of the transportation manage- ment (TM) suite of apps and is used to analyze scheduling results. The results are displayed in a table format with information such as the plan- ning profile, scheduling settings, planning hori- zon, scheduling direction, scheduling strategy, status, and action. Each item can be selected to open more detailed information, such as solu- tion steps. Each activity in the detailed informa- tion area can be viewed chronologically in a Gantt chart.
sections.he:
**Explain Scheduling Results (הסבר תוצאות Scheduling)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו היא חלק מחבילת אפליקציות ה-transportation management (TM) ומשמשת לניתוח תוצאות scheduling. התוצאות מוצגות בפורמט table עם מידע כגון planning profile, scheduling settings, planning horizon, scheduling direction, scheduling strategy, status, ו-action. ניתן לבחור כל item לפתיחת מידע מפורט יותר, כגון solution steps. ניתן לצפות בכל activity באזור המידע המפורט באופן כרונולוגי ב-Gantt chart.

sections.title: Freight Booking Execution
sections.en: Freight Booking Execution (F2677) Application Type: Analytical This overview page holds individual cards that show information related to transportation management (TM) freight bookings. The follow- ing cards are available: ▪ Lifecycle Status Analysis This card shows the number of bookings, grouped by lifecycle status. The statuses avail- able are draft (status 00), new (status 01), and in process (status 02). ▪ Freight Bookings in Transit This card shows the number of freight book- ings that are currently in transit. Drilldown options here allow you to view details of the freight bookings. ▪ Carrier On-Time Performance This card shows the percentage of freight bookings that are delivered on time, split by carrier. Note that a freight booking is only classed as on time if all of its events are classed as on time. ▪ Location Delay Analysis This card shows the number of delayed freight bookings for each location, with an analysis of which events are delayed. ▪ Execution Block Analysis This card shows all freight bookings that have an execution block, grouped by execution block reason. ▪ Delayed Freight Bookings in Transit This card shows all freight bookings that are delayed in transit. The delay here represents the difference between the actual and expected dates. overview page זה מכיל cards בודדים המציגים מידע הקשור ל-freight bookings של transportation management (TM). ה-cards הבאים זמינים:

▪ Freight Bookings in Transit — מציג את מספר ה-freight bookings הנמצאים כעת ב-transit. אפשרויות drilldown מאפשרות לצפות בפרטי ה-freight bookings.
▪ Carrier On-Time Performance — מציג את אחוז ה-freight bookings המסופקים בזמן, מפוצל לפי carrier. שים לב ש-freight booking מסווג כ-on time רק אם כל האירועים שלו מסווגים כ-on time.
▪ Location Delay Analysis — מציג את מספר ה-freight bookings המעוכבים עבור כל location, עם ניתוח אילו אירועים מעוכבים.
▪ Execution Block Analysis — מציג את כל ה-freight bookings בעלי execution block, מקובצים לפי execution block reason.
▪ Delayed Freight Bookings in Transit — מציג את כל ה-freight bookings המעוכבים ב-transit. העיכוב כאן מייצג את ההבדל בין התאריכים actual ל-expected. אפשרויות drilldown זמינות.
▪ Location On-Time Performance — מציג, כאחוז, את ה-freight bookings בזמן עבור כל location. העיכובים מוצגים גם במספרים (לדוגמה, 10/12 events on time).
▪ Planning Block Analysis — מציג את כל ה-freight bookings עם planning block משויך, מקובצים לפי planning block reason.
▪ Blocking Discrepancies — מציג freight bookings עם discrepancy types משויכים, כגון delivery of item או delay.

▪ Non-Blocking Discrepancies — מציג freight bookings עם discrepancy types משויכים שלא הביאו לחסימה.
