sections.en: Manage Work Permits (F6579) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create and manage work permits across their entire lifecycle. You can search and filter permits using criteria such as processing status, work permit number, main work center, technical object, work permit type, technical object type, order, planning plant, planner group, and plant section. Work permits can be created independently, by referencing a maintenance order, from a predefined template, or by copying an existing permit. During cre- ation, you provide essential details such as the planning plant and work permit type, and optionally reference an existing permit or tem- plate. Once created, the permit can be enriched with specific information about the nature of the work, required safety precautions, personal protective equipment, and other safety mea- sures. You can associate multiple functional locations, pieces of equipment, and mainte- nance orders with a single permit and link rele- vant safety certificates. The app supports a structured approval workflow based on the four- eyes principle and allows permits to be printed using customizable output formats. Additional features include application logs for tracking, attachment handling for documentation, filter adaptation, settings customization, and pinning the header for easier navigation.
sections.he:
**Manage Work Permits (ניהול Work Permits)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור ולנהל work permits על פני מחזור החיים המלא שלהם. ניתן לחפש ולסנן permits באמצעות קריטריונים כגון processing status, work permit number, main work center, technical object, work permit type, technical object type, order, planning plant, planner group, ו-plant section. work permits ניתנים ליצירה באופן עצמאי, על ידי הפניה ל-maintenance order, מ-template מוגדר-מראש, או על ידי העתקת permit קיים. במהלך היצירה, מספקים פרטים חיוניים כגון ה-planning plant ו-work permit type. לאחר היצירה, ניתן להעשיר את ה-permit במידע ספציפי על אופי העבודה, safety precautions נדרשים, personal protective equipment, ואמצעי safety אחרים. ניתן לשייך functional locations, equipment, ו-maintenance orders מרובים ל-permit יחיד ולקשר safety certificates רלוונטיים. האפליקציה תומכת ב-approval workflow מובנה על בסיס עקרון ה-four-eyes ומאפשרת הדפסת permits באמצעות output formats ניתנים-להתאמה. תכונות נוספות כוללות application logs, טיפול ב-attachment, התאמת מסננים, התאמת הגדרות, והצמדת ה-header.

sections.title: Mass Schedule Maintenance Plans
sections.en: Mass Schedule Maintenance Plans (F2774) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to efficiently schedule all due maintenance plans within a specified time frame, effectively managing the generation of maintenance call objects such as maintenance orders especially when managing large volumes of data. You can search and filter jobs by status, date range, creator, job ID, and job name. The app lists job records with key details such as job status, log results, job name, planned start time, creator, and more, all adjustable through table settings. It offers options to create new jobs, copy existing ones, view job details, cancel or restart jobs, and export data to Microsoft Excel. During each scheduling run, the system evalu- ates all relevant maintenance plans, factoring in strategies, counters, and plan categories to cal- culate due dates and generate call objects accordingly. It supports various plan types applying their respective cycles and strategies. You can create scheduling jobs by selecting a job template and defining scheduling parameters such as recurrence, calendar, working days, and specific attributes like maintenance strategy, functional location, equipment, and main work center. The app also allows you to review job execution results and logs for better tracking and operational transparency. The app also supports parallel processing, allow- ing you to distribute the workload across multi- ple application servers for more efficient execu- tion. To do this, you need to specify the server group for parallel processing as well as the num- ber of parallel processes. Tip You can use job template SAP_PM_EAM_MASS_ SCHED_MPLAN_T (Mass Schedule – Mainte- nance Plans), corresponding to job catalog entry SAP_PM_EAM_MASS_SCHED_MPLAN.
sections.he:
**Mass Schedule Maintenance Plans (תזמון מסיבי של Maintenance Plans)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לתזמן ביעילות את כל ה-maintenance plans שמועדם הגיע בתוך מסגרת זמן מוגדרת, ומנהלת ביעילות את יצירת ה-maintenance call objects כגון maintenance orders במיוחד בניהול נפחים גדולים של נתונים. ניתן לחפש ולסנן jobs לפי status, date range, creator, job ID, ו-job name. האפליקציה מציגה job records עם פרטי מפתח כגון job status, log results, job name, planned start time, creator, ועוד. היא מציעה אפשרויות ליצירת jobs חדשים, העתקת קיימים, צפייה בפרטי job, ביטול או הפעלה מחדש של jobs, וייצוא נתונים ל-Microsoft Excel. במהלך כל scheduling run, המערכת מעריכה את כל ה-maintenance plans הרלוונטיים, בהתחשב ב-strategies, counters, ו-plan categories לחישוב due dates ויצירת call objects בהתאם. היא תומכת בסוגי plan שונים החלים את ה-cycles וה-strategies שלהם. ניתן ליצור scheduling jobs על ידי בחירת job template והגדרת פרמטרי scheduling כגון recurrence, calendar, working days, ותכונות ספציפיות כמו maintenance strategy, functional location, equipment, ו-main work center.
האפליקציה גם תומכת ב-parallel processing, ומאפשרת להפיץ את עומס העבודה על פני application servers מרובים. לשם כך, יש לציין את ה-server group עבור parallel processing וכן את מספר ה-parallel processes.
**טיפ:** ניתן להשתמש ב-job template SAP_PM_EAM_MASS_SCHED_MPLAN_T (Mass Schedule – Maintenance Plans), המתאים לרשומת ה-job catalog SAP_PM_EAM_MASS_SCHED_MPLAN.

sections.title: Monitor Maintenance Requests
sections.en: Monitor Maintenance Requests (F1511) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create and monitor main- tenance or repair requests for technical objects with ease and efficiency. A search bar and vari- ous filters such as reported by, date, plant sec- tion, room, and system status (e.g., Deletion Flag, Completed, In Process) help you quickly locate specific notifications. Additional filters can be added as needed. From the main screen, you have the option to create new notifications, access settings, or export the list to Microsoft Excel for further analysis. The app supports both © 459 6 Plant Maintenance the creation of new maintenance requests and the tracking of existing ones. Each listed notifi- cation includes details like the notification ID, system status, priority text, technical object, description, date and time, and the user who reported the issue. When submitting a request, you provide details about the technical object and the location of the problem, and you also can upload images or damage descriptions, which are saved as document management sys- tem (DMS) documents. You can opt to receive updates on repair progress. Contact details for the reporter and creator of each request are also available. Tip You also can personalize the tabular view of notifications by using the Standard dropdown to create and manage custom views, tailoring the display to your specific preferences.
sections.he:
**Monitor Maintenance Requests (ניטור Maintenance Requests)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור ולנטר maintenance או repair requests עבור technical objects בקלות וביעילות. search bar ומסננים שונים כגון reported by, date, plant section, room, ו-system status (לדוגמה, Deletion Flag, Completed, In Process) מסייעים לאתר במהירות notifications ספציפיים. ניתן להוסיף מסננים נוספים לפי הצורך. מהמסך הראשי, יש אפשרות ליצור notifications חדשים, לגשת להגדרות, או לייצא את הרשימה ל-Microsoft Excel. האפליקציה תומכת ביצירת maintenance requests חדשים ובמעקב אחר קיימים. כל notification מפורט כולל פרטים כמו ה-notification ID, system status, priority text, technical object, description, date ו-time, וה-user שדיווח על ה-issue. בעת הגשת request, מספקים פרטים על ה-technical object ו-location של הבעיה, וניתן גם להעלות תמונות או damage descriptions, הנשמרים כ-document management system (DMS) documents. ניתן לבחור לקבל עדכונים על repair progress.
**טיפ:** ניתן גם להתאים אישית את התצוגה הטבלאית של notifications באמצעות ה-Standard dropdown.

sections.title: My Inbox – Maintenance Management
sections.en: My Inbox – Maintenance Management (F2953) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to efficiently manage and process maintenance-related tasks from a cen- tralized inbox. You can navigate directly to object lists to work on individual maintenance notifications or maintenance orders, as well as perform mass actions where applicable. The app allows you to view and add comments to tasks for better communication and collaboration. You also can manage attachments by uploading, viewing, or deleting relevant files, ensuring all necessary documentation is readily accessible during task execution.
sections.he:
**My Inbox – Maintenance Management (My Inbox – Maintenance Management)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לנהל ולעבד ביעילות tasks הקשורים ל-maintenance מ-inbox מרכזי. ניתן לנווט ישירות ל-object lists לעבודה על maintenance notifications או maintenance orders בודדים, וכן לבצע mass actions היכן שניתן. האפליקציה מאפשרת לצפות ולהוסיף comments ל-tasks לתקשורת ושיתוף פעולה טובים יותר. ניתן גם לנהל attachments על ידי העלאה, צפייה, או מחיקה של קבצים רלוונטיים.

sections.title: My Maintenance Requests
sections.en: My Maintenance Requests (F4513) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to view and manage your own maintenance requests. You can see all requests you’ve submitted, categorized by sta- tus in tabs: Draft, Submitted, Action Required, Accepted, Rejected, or Completed. Draft requests can be edited or deleted, and submitted or accepted requests can be copied for reuse. If a supervisor needs more information during the screening process, a request may be sent back as Action Required for revision. Accepted requests proceed to planning, and rejected ones cannot be resubmitted. The app provides details such as notification type, order number, due dates, and current phase and subphase. For jobs in the exe- cution phase, you can quickly navigate to related apps like Perform Maintenance Jobs (F5104A). The app also supports visualizing tech- nical object hierarchies based on the functional location’s identifying level. You can assess and assign priority to maintenance requests, which determines critical scheduling dates like start and due dates. If the technical object or notifica- tion type is changed, then the assigned priority is removed. The app also allows you to upload or link relevant documents using predefined or custom document types, which can aid in quicker issue resolution. Tip Although the app is optimized for the Reac- tive (4HH) and Proactive Maintenance (4HI) processes, not all features may function iden- tically for orders outside these scope items, especially if the phase model is not activated as recommended by SAP.
sections.he:
**My Maintenance Requests (Maintenance Requests שלי)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לצפות ולנהל את ה-maintenance requests שלך. ניתן לראות את כל ה-requests שהגשת, מסווגים לפי status בלשוניות: Draft, Submitted, Action Required, Accepted, Rejected, או Completed. requests מסוג draft ניתנים לעריכה או מחיקה, ו-requests מסוג submitted או accepted ניתנים להעתקה לשימוש חוזר. אם supervisor זקוק למידע נוסף במהלך תהליך ה-screening, ייתכן ש-request יישלח בחזרה כ-Action Required לתיקון. requests מאושרים ממשיכים ל-planning, ואלה שנדחו אינם ניתנים להגשה מחדש. האפליקציה מספקת פרטים כגון notification type, order number, due dates, ו-phase ו-subphase נוכחיים. עבור jobs בשלב ה-execution, ניתן לנווט במהירות לאפליקציות קשורות כמו Perform Maintenance Jobs (F5104A). האפליקציה גם תומכת בהמחשת technical object hierarchies. ניתן להעריך ולהקצות priority ל-maintenance requests, הקובע scheduling dates קריטיים. אם ה-technical object או notification type משונה, אז ה-priority המוקצה מוסר.
**טיפ:** אף שהאפליקציה ממוטבת לתהליכי Reactive (4HH) ו-Proactive Maintenance (4HI), ייתכן שלא כל התכונות יתפקדו זהה עבור orders מחוץ ל-scope items אלה, במיוחד אם ה-phase model אינו מופעל כמומלץ על ידי SAP.

sections.title: Perform Maintenance Jobs
sections.en: Perform Maintenance Jobs (F5104A) Application Type: Transactional This app is designed to help you efficiently man- age and execute maintenance jobs that have been dispatched for action. It provides a search bar and a variety of filters such as activity type, assembly, business area, breakdown status, code group, and functional location to narrow down job lists. You can perform key actions using options like Create Maintenance Request, Personal Copy for 6 Plant Maintenance 460 Assign to Me, Quick Confirm, Copy, and various settings to customize the interface. When creat- ing a new maintenance request, you must input essential details including the technical object, current location, effect, breakdown indicator, malfunction start date and time, processing context, description, long text, priority, and reported by/on fields, along with the option to upload attachments, add links, or assign docu- ments. Once a line item from the job list is selected, you can view detailed information organized into sections. The header shows the technical object, maintenance order, order type, processing con- text, notification, subphase, system status, breakdown flag, priority, and current work prog- ress, with an option to display the order bar- code. The Job Details section includes the execu- tion stage, work center, control key, job descriptions, effort details, and job confirma- tions, along with links to related jobs. The Mal- function Data section provides details on the effect, long text, failure mode, and breakdown duration, with the ability to add or copy mal- function data. Through the Add Malfunction Details popup, you can specify damage codes, object parts, causes (including root-cause flags), and activity types, with options to add or delete items. The app allows you to add measurements, plan and record component usage, and attach docu- ments to operations, orders, equipment, loca- tions, or notifications. You can take over jobs, access materials, start, pause, complete tasks, log time, and record failure and measurement data.
sections.he:
**Perform Maintenance Jobs (ביצוע Maintenance Jobs)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מתוכננת לסייע לנהל ולבצע ביעילות maintenance jobs ש-dispatched לפעולה. היא מספקת search bar ומגוון מסננים כגון activity type, assembly, business area, breakdown status, code group, ו-functional location לצמצום רשימות job. ניתן לבצע פעולות מפתח באמצעות אפשרויות כמו Create Maintenance Request, Assign to Me, Quick Confirm, Copy, והגדרות שונות. בעת יצירת maintenance request חדש, יש להזין פרטים חיוניים כולל ה-technical object, current location, effect, breakdown indicator, malfunction start date ו-time, processing context, description, long text, priority, ושדות reported by/on, יחד עם אפשרות להעלות attachments.
לאחר בחירת פריט שורה מרשימת ה-job, ניתן לצפות במידע מפורט מאורגן לחלקים. ה-header מציג את ה-technical object, maintenance order, order type, processing context, notification, subphase, system status, breakdown flag, priority, ו-work progress נוכחי, עם אפשרות להציג את ה-order barcode. חלק ה-Job Details כולל את ה-execution stage, work center, control key, תיאורי job, פרטי effort, ו-job confirmations. חלק ה-Malfunction Data מספק פרטים על ה-effect, long text, failure mode, ו-breakdown duration. דרך ה-popup של Add Malfunction Details, ניתן לציין damage codes, object parts, causes (כולל root-cause flags), ו-activity types.
האפליקציה מאפשרת להוסיף measurements, לתכנן ולרשום component usage, ולצרף documents ל-operations, orders, equipment, locations, או notifications. ניתן ליטול jobs, לגשת ל-materials, להתחיל, להשהות, להשלים tasks, לרשום זמן, ולרשום נתוני failure ו-measurement.

sections.title: Permit to Work Overview
sections.en: Permit to Work Overview (F7304) Application Type: Analytical This app offers you a consolidated view of open work permits and safety certificates associated with a specific planning plant. You can filter the data by fields such as planning plant (as a key field), maintenance plant, planner group, and work center and more. The app displays critical metrics, including permit and certificate types, processing statuses, and their distribution across various work centers. You can refine the view by selecting additional location units within the planning plant and applying custom filters. From the overview, you can navigate to related applications for deeper analysis and fol- low-up actions.
sections.he:
**Permit to Work Overview (סקירת Permit to Work)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מציעה תצוגה מאוחדת של open work permits ו-safety certificates המשויכים ל-planning plant ספציפי. ניתן לסנן את הנתונים לפי שדות כגון planning plant (כשדה מפתח), maintenance plant, planner group, ו-work center ועוד. האפליקציה מציגה מטריקות קריטיות, כולל permit ו-certificate types, processing statuses, וההפצה שלהם על פני work centers שונים. ניתן לחדד את התצוגה על ידי בחירת location units נוספים בתוך ה-planning plant והחלת מסננים מותאמים. מהסקירה, ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות קשורות לניתוח ופעולות follow-up עמוקים יותר.

sections.title: Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Order)
sections.en: Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Order) (F2827) Application Type: Transactional This app provides you with a detailed view of all purchase order items created for maintenance orders, along with key procurement informa- tion. It features a search bar and a range of filters including reference date, release status (e.g., active, in release, release completed, or refused), equipment, whether components are missing, maintenance order numbers, and more. The app lists purchase order items with details like mate- rial, release status, item ID, order quantity, refer- ence date, net order value, and other fields based on the selected table settings. You can expand the view using the Show More per Row option to display additional information such as mainte- nance order operation, priority, and purchasing group. Selecting a specific purchase order item opens the Purchase Order app (F0348A), where you can view comprehensive details including supplier name, net value, creation details, pur- chasing organization, detailed item informa- tion, purchase requisition and contract links, goods receipts, supplier invoices, notes, attach- ments, and approval status. You can access this app via the Purchase Orders Not Approved or Missing Components card in the Maintenance Planning Overview app (F2828), or through the External Procurement card in the Maintenance Backlog Overview app (5105). The system presents a prefiltered list based on the navigation path to help you quickly identify issues such as unapproved pur- chase orders or missing components. © 461 6 Plant Maintenance
sections.he:
**Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Order) (Procurement for Maintenance Planner – Purchase Order)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מספקת תצוגה מפורטת של כל ה-purchase order items שנוצרו עבור maintenance orders, יחד עם מידע procurement מרכזי. היא כוללת search bar ומגוון מסננים כולל reference date, release status (לדוגמה, active, in release, release completed, או refused), equipment, אם components חסרים, maintenance order numbers, ועוד. האפליקציה מציגה purchase order items עם פרטים כמו material, release status, item ID, order quantity, reference date, net order value, ושדות אחרים. ניתן להרחיב את התצוגה באמצעות אפשרות Show More per Row להצגת מידע נוסף כגון maintenance order operation, priority, ו-purchasing group. בחירת purchase order item ספציפי פותחת את אפליקציית Purchase Order (F0348A), שבה ניתן לצפות בפרטים מקיפים כולל supplier name, net value, פרטי creation, purchasing organization, מידע item מפורט, קישורי purchase requisition ו-contract, goods receipts, supplier invoices, notes, attachments, ו-approval status.
ניתן לגשת לאפליקציה זו דרך card ה-Purchase Orders Not Approved או Missing Components באפליקציית Maintenance Planning Overview (F2828), או דרך card ה-External Procurement באפליקציית Maintenance Backlog Overview (F5105).

sections.title: Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Requisition)
sections.en: Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Requisition) (F3065) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to view a comprehensive list of all purchase requisition items created for maintenance orders, along with key procure- ment details. It includes a search bar and various filters such as reference date, release status, fixed vendor, location plant, order type, mate- rial, purchasing group, and more to refine search results. The app displays requisition details including material, quantity requested, reference date, maintenance order operation, and other fields based on user-defined table set- tings. You can customize your view further using options like Show More per Row, Adapt Filters, Export to Excel, Save View as Tile, and direct navigation to related applications. You can access this app through cards in the Maintenance Planning Overview app (F2828), such as Purchase Requisitions Not Converted to Purchase Orders. It offers a prefiltered list based on how you accessed the app, making it easier to identify requisitions that need attention, like those pending approval or conversion. For each item, you can view detailed procurement data including release status, supplier, requested materials, requirement dates, and any linked purchase orders, ensuring effective procure- ment tracking and follow-up. Report Malfunction (F2023) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create malfunction reports through the Create Malfunction Report screen, where you can enter essential details such as the technical object, a brief description, a more detailed explanation in the long text field, and the effect of the malfunction—whether it has no impact, restricts production, or causes a complete production breakdown. You also can specify the current location, date and time the issue was reported, and the name of the person reporting it, and assign the task to a responsible individual. The app also allows you to upload attachments, add relevant links, and take advan- tage of built-in scanning capabilities. Request Maintenance (F1511) Application Type: Transactional This app facilitates the process of submitting and monitoring maintenance or repair requests for technical objects. You begin by selecting a technical object—either equipment or a func- tional location—and entering key details such as the notification type (e.g., work request, activ- ity report, install/dismantle), a brief description, long text for detailed information, current loca- tion, the effect on operations (e.g., no effect, pro- duction restricted, or breakdown), date and time, and the person reporting the issue. Attach- ments or links also can be added to support the request. You have the option to submit the noti- fication, view the notification list, or use a default template when entering details. Once submitted, the notification appears in a detailed list of notifications with the notification ID, sys- tem status, technical object, description, date, and time based on the table settings. You can then view more information in the dedicated Notification screen. The app features two main options: one for sub- mitting new notifications and another for track- ing existing ones, using the Submit and Notifi- cation List options. You can personalize the view, apply filters, and save layouts as variants, which can even be pinned as home page tiles for easy access. More importantly, you also can be notified of the progress.
sections.he:
**Procurement for Maintenance Planner (Purchase Requisition) (Procurement for Maintenance Planner – Purchase Requisition)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לצפות ברשימה מקיפה של כל ה-purchase requisition items שנוצרו עבור maintenance orders, יחד עם פרטי procurement מרכזיים. היא כוללת search bar ומסננים שונים כגון reference date, release status, fixed vendor, location plant, order type, material, purchasing group, ועוד לחידוד תוצאות החיפוש. האפליקציה מציגה פרטי requisition כולל material, quantity requested, reference date, maintenance order operation, ושדות אחרים על בסיס table settings מוגדרי-משתמש. ניתן להתאים את התצוגה באמצעות אפשרויות כמו Show More per Row, Adapt Filters, Export to Excel, Save View as Tile, וניווט ישיר לאפליקציות קשורות.
ניתן לגשת לאפליקציה זו דרך cards באפליקציית Maintenance Planning Overview (F2828), כגון Purchase Requisitions Not Converted to Purchase Orders. היא מציעה רשימה מסוננת-מראש על בסיס אופן הגישה לאפליקציה. עבור כל item, ניתן לצפות בנתוני procurement מפורטים כולל release status, supplier, materials מבוקשים, requirement dates, וכל purchase orders מקושרים.

sections.title: Schedule Material Availability Check
sections.en: Schedule Material Availability Check (F2465) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to perform material avail- ability checks for multiple maintenance orders Personal Copy for 6 Plant Maintenance 462 either instantly or by scheduling them as recur- ring batch jobs. A search bar and filters such as job status (failed, canceled, scheduled, ready, etc.), date range, and job ID help you locate spe- cific jobs. The app displays a detailed list of jobs, including their status, logs, results, steps, job name, creator, planned start time, and other rel- evant information. Follow a step-by-step pro- cess to set up a job: 1. First you select a job template and enter a description. 2. Next, you define the scheduling options, including recurrence patterns. 3. Finally, you configure parameters such as error and exception display settings, log-sav- ing preferences, and parallel processing options like thread count and activation. You also can define order statuses (e.g., in pro- cess, completed) and specific order parameters. The app also includes options to schedule, check, cancel, and manage templates via the Template feature. When run as a batch job, the system generates a report that includes any errors or warnings encountered, along with the updated system and user statuses of the rele- vant orders. This app also can be accessed through the Find Maintenance Orders app (F2175). Tip You can use the SAP_PM_EAM_ATP_RIAUFK20_T (PM Orders: Material Availability Check) job template.
sections.he:
**Schedule Material Availability Check (תזמון Material Availability Check)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לבצע material availability checks עבור maintenance orders מרובים או מיד או על ידי תזמונם כ-recurring batch jobs. search bar ומסננים כגון job status (failed, canceled, scheduled, ready, וכו'), date range, ו-job ID מסייעים לאתר jobs ספציפיים. האפליקציה מציגה רשימה מפורטת של jobs, כולל ה-status, logs, results, steps, job name, creator, planned start time, ומידע רלוונטי אחר שלהם. עקוב אחר תהליך שלב-אחר-שלב להגדרת job:
1. תחילה בוחרים job template ומזינים description.
2. בשלב הבא, מגדירים את אפשרויות ה-scheduling, כולל recurrence patterns.
3. לבסוף, מגדירים פרמטרים כגון הגדרות error ו-exception display, העדפות log-saving, ואפשרויות parallel processing כמו thread count ו-activation.
ניתן גם להגדיר order statuses (לדוגמה, in process, completed) ופרמטרי order ספציפיים. כאשר מורץ כ-batch job, המערכת יוצרת דוח הכולל כל שגיאות או אזהרות. ניתן לגשת לאפליקציה זו גם דרך אפליקציית Find Maintenance Orders (F2175).
**טיפ:** ניתן להשתמש ב-job template SAP_PM_EAM_ATP_RIAUFK20_T (PM Orders: Material Availability Check).

sections.title: Schedule Output for Maintenance Job Packs
sections.en: Schedule Output for Maintenance Job Packs (F6076) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create and schedule appli- cation jobs for generating output related to maintenance job packs. Using the app, you can select job packs based on various parameters, define specific times and dates for output gener- ation, set recurring schedules, or trigger outputs immediately. Before scheduling, the app vali- dates the input data. It also provides access to logs for each job, allowing you to track success or failure and filter job entries by criteria such as date, job name, status, or creator. You also can duplicate existing jobs to fast-track the creation of similar ones.
sections.he:
**Schedule Output for Maintenance Job Packs (תזמון Output עבור Maintenance Job Packs)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור ולתזמן application jobs ליצירת output הקשור ל-maintenance job packs. באמצעות האפליקציה, ניתן לבחור job packs על בסיס פרמטרים שונים, להגדיר זמנים ותאריכים ספציפיים ליצירת output, להגדיר לוחות recurring, או להפעיל outputs מיד. לפני התזמון, האפליקציה מאמתת את נתוני הקלט. היא גם מספקת גישה ל-logs עבור כל job, ומאפשרת לעקוב אחר הצלחה או כישלון ולסנן רשומות job לפי קריטריונים כגון date, job name, status, או creator. ניתן גם לשכפל jobs קיימים לזירוז יצירת דומים.

sections.title: Schedule Output for Maintenance Notifications
sections.en: Schedule Output for Maintenance Notifications (F6074) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create application jobs that schedule the output for maintenance noti- fications. With this app, you can define when and how maintenance notifications are output, helping streamline communication and docu- mentation across your maintenance processes.
sections.he:
**Schedule Output for Maintenance Notifications (תזמון Output עבור Maintenance Notifications)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור application jobs המתזמנים את ה-output עבור maintenance notifications. באמצעות אפליקציה זו, ניתן להגדיר מתי וכיצד maintenance notifications מופקות, ומסייע לייעל תקשורת ותיעוד על פני תהליכי ה-maintenance שלך.

sections.title: Schedule Output for Maintenance Orders
sections.en: Schedule Output for Maintenance Orders (F6075) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to create and manage appli- cation jobs specifically for scheduling the out- put of maintenance orders. You can define new output jobs by selecting the relevant mainte- nance orders and configuring output parame- ters, including timing options such as immedi- ate, scheduled for a specific date and time, or set to recur at defined intervals. Before confirming the schedule, you can review and validate the job setup. Once a job is created, it appears in the Application Jobs list, where you can monitor its execution status, view detailed logs to check for success or failure, and apply filters based on job name, creation date, or status. The app also allows you to copy existing jobs, making it eas- ier to reuse configurations for similar tasks. Sup- ported output channels include email and print, ensuring timely and accurate distribution of maintenance orders. © 463 6 Plant Maintenance
sections.he:
**Schedule Output for Maintenance Orders (תזמון Output עבור Maintenance Orders)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת ליצור ולנהל application jobs ספציפית לתזמון ה-output של maintenance orders. ניתן להגדיר output jobs חדשים על ידי בחירת ה-maintenance orders הרלוונטיים והגדרת פרמטרי output, כולל אפשרויות timing כגון immediate, scheduled עבור תאריך וזמן ספציפיים, או recurring במרווחים מוגדרים. לפני אישור התזמון, ניתן לסקור ולאמת את הגדרת ה-job. לאחר יצירת job, הוא מופיע ברשימת ה-Application Jobs, שבה ניתן לנטר את ה-status execution שלו, לצפות ב-logs מפורטים, ולהחיל מסננים על בסיס job name, creation date, או status. האפליקציה גם מאפשרת להעתיק jobs קיימים. output channels נתמכים כוללים email ו-print.

sections.title: Screen Maintenance Requests
sections.en: Screen Maintenance Requests (F4072) Application Type: Transactional This app provides a centralized platform for managing maintenance requests, allowing you to search and filter by various criteria such as notification ID, planning plant, planner group, work center, priority level, notification type, equipment, and technical object type. Mainte- nance requests are organized into tabs—Open, Action Required, Accepted, Rejected, and Com- pleted—with details like notification ID, prior- ity, technical object, and ABC indicator dis- played based on the table settings. You can take actions such as accepting, rejecting, changing responsibility, copying, adjusting settings, or exporting data to Excel. The app allows you to view comprehensive request details including status, malfunction data, and equipment hierar- chy. Accepted requests move forward for plan- ning and execution, while rejected ones are logged with reasons and locked from further edits. You also can manage output documents, customize them through output control set- tings, and upload related files. The maintenance request app includes several key tabs. The General Information tab displays core technical and logistical details such as the technical object, location data, and responsible area. The Hierarchy tab shows a structured view of related technical objects, open requests, and orders, with links to additional system data. Malfunction Information captures details about the issue, including descriptions, causes, and failure data. Prioritization & Criticality outlines priority levels and scheduling dates. The Attach- ments tab allows you to view relevant docu- ments or links. Maintenance Plan Details shows preventive maintenance links like task lists and plan items. Finally, Output Items tracks commu- nication records and allows you to manage out- put-related actions. Tip The app supports logging changes to the maintenance as history for later review. Changes can be viewed in the Technical Object screen, detailing the edit type (e.g., Sys- tem Status Change), the field name that was changed, the old value and new value, and the person who changed it.
sections.he:
**Screen Maintenance Requests (Screen Maintenance Requests)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מספקת פלטפורמה מרכזית לניהול maintenance requests, ומאפשרת לחפש ולסנן לפי קריטריונים שונים כגון notification ID, planning plant, planner group, work center, priority level, notification type, equipment, ו-technical object type. maintenance requests מאורגנים ללשוניות — Open, Action Required, Accepted, Rejected, ו-Completed — עם פרטים כמו notification ID, priority, technical object, ו-ABC indicator. ניתן לנקוט פעולות כגון accepting, rejecting, שינוי responsibility, העתקה, התאמת הגדרות, או ייצוא נתונים ל-Excel. האפליקציה מאפשרת לצפות בפרטי request מקיפים כולל status, malfunction data, ו-equipment hierarchy. requests מאושרים מתקדמים ל-planning ו-execution, בעוד אלה שנדחו נרשמים עם reasons ונעולים מעריכה נוספת.
אפליקציית ה-maintenance request כוללת מספר לשוניות מפתח. לשונית General Information מציגה פרטי technical ו-logistical מרכזיים. לשונית Hierarchy מציגה תצוגה מובנית של technical objects קשורים. Malfunction Information לוכד פרטים על ה-issue, כולל descriptions, causes, ו-failure data. Prioritization & Criticality מתאר priority levels ו-scheduling dates. לשונית Attachments מאפשרת לצפות ב-documents או קישורים רלוונטיים. Maintenance Plan Details מציג קישורי preventive maintenance כמו task lists ו-plan items. לבסוף, Output Items עוקב אחר רשומות תקשורת.
**טיפ:** האפליקציה תומכת ברישום שינויים ל-maintenance כ-history לסקירה מאוחרת.

sections.title: Technical Object Breakdowns
sections.en: Technical Object Breakdowns (F2812) Application Type: Analytical This app allows you to thoroughly analyze the frequency, causes, and duration of equipment breakdowns, offering key insights into repair trends and downtime patterns. You can apply a wide range of filters such as maintenance plant, planning plant, object type, catalog profile, tech- nical object type, main work center, and ABC indicator to refine the data and focus on specific breakdown scenarios. The app supports flexible viewing options, allowing you to toggle between chart view, table view, and a combined view (table and chart), and it includes tools like zoom, chart screen maximization, and legends to improve data interpretation. In the table set- tings, you can copy data, configure the table view using the Settings option, export to Micro- soft Excel, and show all items with detailed col- umns such as maintenance plant, object type, number of reported breakdowns, total repair time in hours, mean time to repair, and time between repairs. The app calculates key metrics like mean total time to repair and mean time between repairs, and it effectively breaks down data by model number, planning plant, break- down quarter, activity type, assembly, and more. You can use the Visual Filter option to view the following charts: Personal Copy for 6 Plant Maintenance 464 ▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Type of Tech- nical Object ▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by ABC Indicator for Technical Object ▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Maintenance Planning Plant ▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Main Work Center for Maintenance Tasks Tip The C_MAINTOBJBREAKDOWNQUERY_CDS (Mainte- nance Object Breakdown Query) service must activated and maintained. The app uses CDS view C_MAINTOBJBREAKDOWNQUERY.
sections.he:
**Technical Object Breakdowns (תקלות Technical Object)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לנתח ביסודיות את התדירות, הסיבות, ומשך ה-equipment breakdowns, ומציעה תובנות מפתח למגמות repair ולדפוסי downtime. ניתן להחיל מגוון רחב של מסננים כגון maintenance plant, planning plant, object type, catalog profile, technical object type, main work center, ו-ABC indicator לחידוד הנתונים ולהתמקדות בתרחישי breakdown ספציפיים. האפליקציה תומכת באפשרויות צפייה גמישות, ומאפשרת להחליף בין chart view, table view, ותצוגה משולבת (table ו-chart), והיא כוללת כלים כמו zoom, מקסום מסך chart, ו-legends. בהגדרות ה-table, ניתן להעתיק נתונים, להגדיר את תצוגת ה-table, לייצא ל-Microsoft Excel, ולהציג את כל ה-items עם עמודות מפורטות כגון maintenance plant, object type, מספר ה-reported breakdowns, total repair time בשעות, mean time to repair, ו-time between repairs. האפליקציה מחשבת מטריקות מפתח כמו mean total time to repair ו-mean time between repairs.
ניתן להשתמש באפשרות Visual Filter לצפייה ב-charts הבאים:
▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Type of Technical Object
▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by ABC Indicator for Technical Object
▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Maintenance Planning Plant
▪ No of Reported Breakdowns by Main Work Center for Maintenance Tasks
**טיפ:** יש להפעיל ולתחזק את ה-service C_MAINTOBJBREAKDOWNQUERY_CDS (Maintenance Object Breakdown Query). האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_MAINTOBJBREAKDOWNQUERY.

sections.title: Technical Object Damages
sections.en: Technical Object Damages (F3075) Application Type: Analytical This app is designed to help you analyze recur- ring damages and identify the technical objects most frequently affected. It provides a central- ized view of related maintenance notifications linked to specific maintenance items, enabling better reliability tracking and root-cause analy- sis. You can visualize damage data either in chart or table format, or both simultaneously, and apply various filters such as maintenance plant, object type, construction type, catalog profile, notification year (e.g., 2024 and 2025, with an option to add more), and so on. The app highlights important details, showing metrics like the number of causes, number of activities, and number of object parts. You can drill down into specific maintenance notifications, techni- cal object labels, and functional locations to gain deeper insight into the nature and frequency of damage. Each listed item includes data such as damage type, technical object, and associated corrective actions. The app offers multiple dis- play options and allows you to switch between table view, chart view, and a combined layout (table and chart). SAP notes that rendering com- plex data may cause slight delays, but the app remains an invaluable asset for maintenance teams focused on improving operational reli- ability and minimizing equipment-related issues. You can utilize the following charts using the Visual Filter option: ▪ Damage by Effect ▪ Damage by Object Type ▪ Damage by Construction Type ▪ Damage by Catalog Profile ▪ Damage by Notification Year ▪ Damage by Object Part Code Group ▪ Damage by Damage Code Group ▪ Damage by Cause Code Group ▪ Damage by Activity Code Group You also can select the following chart measures when displaying results in chart view: activities, causes of damage, damage, and object parts. Tip The C_DAMAGEANALYSISQUERY_CDS (Damage Analysis Query) service should be activated and maintained for this app. The app uses CDS view C_DAMAGEANALYSISQUERY. ©
sections.he:
**Technical Object Damages (נזקי Technical Object)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מתוכננת לסייע לנתח נזקים חוזרים ולזהות את ה-technical objects המושפעים בתדירות הגבוהה ביותר. היא מספקת תצוגה מרכזית של maintenance notifications קשורים המקושרים ל-maintenance items ספציפיים, ומאפשרת מעקב reliability ו-root-cause analysis טובים יותר. ניתן להמחיש נתוני damage או בפורמט chart או table, או שניהם בו-זמנית, ולהחיל מסננים שונים כגון maintenance plant, object type, construction type, catalog profile, notification year (לדוגמה, 2024 ו-2025), וכן הלאה. האפליקציה מבליטה פרטים חשובים, ומציגה מטריקות כמו מספר ה-causes, מספר ה-activities, ומספר ה-object parts. ניתן לבצע drill-down ל-maintenance notifications ספציפיים, technical object labels, ו-functional locations. כל item מפורט כולל נתונים כגון damage type, technical object, ו-corrective actions משויכים. SAP מציינת ש-rendering של נתונים מורכבים עלול לגרום לעיכובים קלים.
ניתן לנצל את ה-charts הבאים באמצעות אפשרות Visual Filter:
▪ Damage by Effect
▪ Damage by Object Type
▪ Damage by Construction Type
▪ Damage by Catalog Profile
▪ Damage by Notification Year
▪ Damage by Object Part Code Group
▪ Damage by Damage Code Group
▪ Damage by Cause Code Group
▪ Damage by Activity Code Group
ניתן גם לבחור את ה-chart measures הבאים בעת הצגת תוצאות ב-chart view: activities, causes of damage, damage, ו-object parts.
**טיפ:** יש להפעיל ולתחזק את ה-service C_DAMAGEANALYSISQUERY_CDS (Damage Analysis Query). האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_DAMAGEANALYSISQUERY.

sections.title: Adjust Operational Supplier Evaluation Score
sections.en: Adjust Operational Supplier Evaluation Score (F2312) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to adjust the operational evaluation score of a supplier. The app show- cases the option to display All, Only Updated, or Not Updated supplier evaluation scores. You can view supplier evaluation scores based on several sorting and filtering parameters, such as quan- tity score, time score, price score, and inspection lot score, as well as several other factors relevant for process owners. The operational score can be updated by modifying the individual scores that contribute to the operational score for a specific supplier using the Edit icon. As a business pro- gresses, the app becomes invaluable for process owners; there will be a need to adjust these scores as more data is collected. This helps you to have the most recent evaluation data. Fur- thermore, you can remove recently updated scores using the Discard Updated Scores button.
sections.he:
**Adjust Operational Supplier Evaluation Score (התאמת Operational Supplier Evaluation Score)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת להתאים את ה-operational evaluation score של supplier. האפליקציה מציגה אפשרות להציג All, Only Updated, או Not Updated של supplier evaluation scores. ניתן לצפות ב-supplier evaluation scores על בסיס מספר פרמטרי מיון וסינון, כגון quantity score, time score, price score, ו-inspection lot score, וכן מספר גורמים אחרים. ניתן לעדכן את ה-operational score על ידי שינוי ה-scores הבודדים התורמים ל-operational score עבור supplier ספציפי באמצעות אייקון Edit. יתרה מכך, ניתן להסיר scores שעודכנו לאחרונה באמצעות כפתור Discard Updated Scores.

sections.title: Analyze Missing Exchange Rates
sections.en: Analyze Missing Exchange Rates (F4360) Application Type: Transactional This app helps you find and fix missing exchange rates for various purchasing docu- ments such as purchase orders, central purchase orders, purchase contracts, quotations, and so on. Business users can narrow the search using parameters such as validity dates, target and document currencies, purchasing document type, and more. Besides viewing purchase docu- ments with missing exchange rates, you also can maintain rates by using the Maintain Exchange Rates option to enter details such as the exchange rate type, currencies, validity dates, quotation method, and exchange rate. Furthermore, you can export the list of purchas- ing documents with missing exchange rates using the Export or Export As functionality. Business users will need to make sure that ser- vice group UI_CMIS_MYFILES_04 (CMIS My Files UI Service) has been published for the export functionality to work properly. For instance, you can export the purchasing document list as either an XLSX file or a PDF. This app can be accessed through the Monitor Missing Exchange Rates card from the Monitor Purchasing Analytics Operation app (F4339). The app uses CDS view C_MONITORMISSINGEXCHRATE to retrieve data. Tip The app applies maintained exchange rates to all purchasing documents with the same or later document dates, whereas previous dates are not affected. Personal Copy for 7 Materials Management 466 In addition, missing exchange rates entries will disappear from the list once updated.
sections.he:
**Analyze Missing Exchange Rates (ניתוח Exchange Rates חסרים)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מסייעת למצוא ולתקן exchange rates חסרים עבור purchasing documents שונים כגון purchase orders, central purchase orders, purchase contracts, quotations, וכן הלאה. business users יכולים לצמצם את החיפוש באמצעות פרמטרים כגון validity dates, target ו-document currencies, purchasing document type, ועוד. מלבד צפייה ב-purchase documents עם exchange rates חסרים, ניתן גם לתחזק rates באמצעות אפשרות Maintain Exchange Rates להזנת פרטים כגון ה-exchange rate type, currencies, validity dates, quotation method, ו-exchange rate. יתרה מכך, ניתן לייצא את רשימת ה-purchasing documents עם exchange rates חסרים באמצעות פונקציונליות Export או Export As. יש לוודא ש-service group UI_CMIS_MYFILES_04 (CMIS My Files UI Service) פורסם כדי שפונקציונליות הייצוא תעבוד.
ניתן לגשת לאפליקציה זו דרך card ה-Monitor Missing Exchange Rates מאפליקציית Monitor Purchasing Analytics Operation (F4339). האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_MONITORMISSINGEXCHRATE לאחזור נתונים.
**טיפ:** האפליקציה מחילה exchange rates מתוחזקים על כל ה-purchasing documents עם document dates זהים או מאוחרים יותר, בעוד תאריכים קודמים אינם מושפעים. בנוסף, רשומות exchange rates חסרים ייעלמו מהרשימה לאחר העדכון.

sections.title: Analyze Stock in Date Range
sections.en: Analyze Stock in Date Range (F6185) Application Type: Transactional This app can be used to track and monitor stock movements for one or more materials across multiple plants and storage locations with a selected date range, which helps in identifying trends to ensure proper inventory management and addressing stock discrepancies. An inven- tory manager can view stock levels and move- ments during specific time frames and analyze inventory trends to support forecasting and replenishment decisions. You can narrow the search by using filter criteria such as display cur- rency, analytical date range, plant, material, storage location, stock type (e.g., unrestricted- use stock), special stock type (e.g., project stock, supplier consignment), and so on. Business users can create and schedule export jobs with predefined or custom templates for material stock and postings or material stock with the following options: exclude reversal postings or exclude postings without stock. The Schedule Export option navigates you to the Schedule Export of Inventory Analytics app (F7493). You can use the View By option to customize chart views using dimensions like material, plant, sales order, supplier, batch, and more. The Details option allows you to view in-depth stock data like plant, currency, and stock value, with further options to toggle between chart and table views for flexibility. For detailed analysis for a selected material, you can track material postings, including stock quantities and values for the selected period, fil- ter data by movement types, and exclude rever- sal movements. In the Material Postings tab for selected material, you can navigate to the Mate- rial Documents Overview app (F1077). More importantly, you also can navigate to the Com- pliance Information (F3226) and Manage Product Master Data (F1602) apps for further processing and analysis. The app flexibly integrates with the Stock-Single Material app (F1076) or Material Documents Overview app (F1077). Tip Access to financial data may be restricted based on user authorization.
sections.he:
**Analyze Stock in Date Range (ניתוח מלאי בטווח תאריכים)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת למעקב וניטור של stock movements עבור material אחד או יותר על פני plants ו-storage locations מרובים בטווח תאריכים נבחר, המסייע בזיהוי מגמות להבטחת inventory management נכון. inventory manager יכול לצפות ב-stock levels ו-movements במסגרות זמן ספציפיות ולנתח מגמות inventory לתמיכה בהחלטות forecasting ו-replenishment. ניתן לצמצם את החיפוש באמצעות קריטריוני סינון כגון display currency, analytical date range, plant, material, storage location, stock type (לדוגמה, unrestricted-use stock), special stock type (לדוגמה, project stock, supplier consignment), וכן הלאה. business users יכולים ליצור ולתזמן export jobs עם templates מוגדרים-מראש או מותאמים. אפשרות Schedule Export מנווטת לאפליקציית Schedule Export of Inventory Analytics (F7493). ניתן להשתמש באפשרות View By להתאמת תצוגות chart באמצעות dimensions כמו material, plant, sales order, supplier, batch, ועוד. אפשרות Details מאפשרת לצפות בנתוני stock מעמיקים כמו plant, currency, ו-stock value.
לניתוח מפורט עבור material נבחר, ניתן לעקוב אחר material postings, כולל stock quantities ו-values עבור התקופה הנבחרת, לסנן נתונים לפי movement types, ולהחריג reversal movements. בלשונית Material Postings עבור material נבחר, ניתן לנווט לאפליקציית Material Documents Overview (F1077). חשוב יותר, ניתן גם לנווט לאפליקציות Compliance Information (F3226) ו-Manage Product Master Data (F1602). האפליקציה משתלבת בגמישות עם אפליקציית Stock – Single Material (F1076) או Material Documents Overview (F1077).
**טיפ:** גישה לנתונים פיננסיים עשויה להיות מוגבלת על בסיס user authorization.

sections.title: Central Procurement Interface Monitor
sections.en: Central Procurement Interface Monitor (F3913) Application Type: Transactional The app helps monitor and address issues in central procurement processes by displaying failed transactions—for instance, central con- tracts and requisitions. It allows business to investigate issues or dismiss irrelevant ones. Fil- ter options include purchasing object ID, con- nected system, purchasing object, and so on. The main function of the app is to investigate or dismiss failures. Using the Investigate option allows you to identify the reasons for failed transactions by navigating the relevant applica- tion or transaction in the hub system or con- nected systems. The Dismiss option allows you to remove resolved or irrelevant failed transac- tions from the list.
sections.he:
**Central Procurement Interface Monitor (Central Procurement Interface Monitor)** — Application Type: Transactional.
האפליקציה מסייעת לנטר ולטפל בבעיות בתהליכי central procurement על ידי הצגת transactions שנכשלו — לדוגמה, central contracts ו-requisitions. היא מאפשרת לעסק לחקור בעיות או לבטל לא-רלוונטיות. אפשרויות סינון כוללות purchasing object ID, connected system, purchasing object, וכן הלאה. הפונקציה הראשית של האפליקציה היא לחקור או לבטל failures. שימוש באפשרות Investigate מאפשר לזהות את הסיבות ל-transactions שנכשלו על ידי ניווט ל-application או transaction רלוונטיים ב-hub system או connected systems. אפשרות Dismiss מאפשרת להסיר failed transactions שנפתרו או לא-רלוונטיים מהרשימה.

sections.title: Central Procurement Job Monitor
sections.en: Central Procurement Job Monitor (F3914) Application Type: Transactional This app helps monitor and manage central pro- curement jobs by listing failed extraction jobs. It allows you to investigate issues, restart jobs or dismiss irrelevant ones using filters such as on connected system, creation date, and so on. Using the View Job Details option, you can open the job list to understand the reason for failure and, if needed, create a new job. Using the Restart Job option, you can retry failed jobs to resume the process, and the Dismiss option © 467 7 Materials Management allows for the removal of irrelevant or resolved failed jobs from the list.
sections.he:
**Central Procurement Job Monitor (Central Procurement Job Monitor)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מסייעת לנטר ולנהל central procurement jobs על ידי רישום extraction jobs שנכשלו. היא מאפשרת לחקור בעיות, להפעיל מחדש jobs או לבטל לא-רלוונטיים באמצעות מסננים כגון on connected system, creation date, וכן הלאה. באמצעות אפשרות View Job Details, ניתן לפתוח את ה-job list להבנת סיבת ה-failure ו, אם נדרש, ליצור job חדש. באמצעות אפשרות Restart Job, ניתן לנסות שוב jobs שנכשלו לחידוש התהליך, ואפשרות Dismiss מאפשרת הסרת jobs שנכשלו לא-רלוונטיים או שנפתרו מהרשימה.

sections.title: Central Procurement Operations Monitor
sections.en: Central Procurement Operations Monitor (F3912) Application Type: Analytic The app helps monitor central procurement operations through various overview cards, highlighting issues that need attention. It allows you to investigate errors, track job failures, and check the compatibility of business operations across connected systems. You can add or remove cards on the initial app screen by mak- ing use of the Manage Cards option. The follow- ing cards can be found on the Central Procure- ment Operations Monitor screen: ▪ Central Requisitioning Monitor failed purchase requisitions and source of supply extraction jobs. View and address failed transactions using the Central Procurement Interface Monitor app (F3913) and the Central Procurement Job Monitor app (F3914). ▪ Central Purchasing Track failed extraction jobs for purchase req- uisitions, purchase orders, and text data. Investigate and restart failed jobs, and dis- miss resolved or irrelevant failures from the hit list using the Central Procurement Job Monitor app (F3914). ▪ Central Contract Management Check failed contract distributions and release order update jobs. Navigate to the Central Procurement Interface Monitor app (F3913) and see central procurement interface failures so that you can investigate or dismiss failures. ▪ Features and Systems Compatibility Ensure compatibility of business operations with system requirements/versions. ▪ Connected Systems Monitor the online/offline status of con- nected systems.
sections.he:
**Central Procurement Operations Monitor (Central Procurement Operations Monitor)** — Application Type: Analytic.
האפליקציה מסייעת לנטר central procurement operations דרך cards סקירה שונים, ומבליטה בעיות הדורשות תשומת לב. היא מאפשרת לחקור שגיאות, לעקוב אחר job failures, ולבדוק את התאימות של business operations על פני connected systems. ניתן להוסיף או להסיר cards במסך הראשוני באמצעות אפשרות Manage Cards. ה-cards הבאים נמצאים במסך Central Procurement Operations Monitor:
▪ Central Requisitioning — מנטר purchase requisitions ו-source of supply extraction jobs שנכשלו. צפייה וטיפול ב-transactions שנכשלו באמצעות אפליקציות Central Procurement Interface Monitor (F3913) ו-Central Procurement Job Monitor (F3914).
▪ Central Purchasing — מעקב אחר extraction jobs שנכשלו עבור purchase requisitions, purchase orders, ו-text data. חקירה והפעלה מחדש של jobs שנכשלו באמצעות אפליקציית Central Procurement Job Monitor (F3914).
▪ Central Contract Management — בדיקת contract distributions ו-release order update jobs שנכשלו. ניווט לאפליקציית Central Procurement Interface Monitor (F3913).
▪ Features and Systems Compatibility — הבטחת תאימות של business operations עם דרישות/גרסאות מערכת.
▪ Connected Systems — ניטור ה-status של online/offline של connected systems.

sections.title: Central Purchase Contract Consumption
sections.en: Central Purchase Contract Consumption (F3444) Application Type: Analytical This analytical app helps you to track the con- sumption of central purchase contracts, com- paring the released quantity against the target quantity from the previous year to date. It sup- ports quick insights through flexible filtering and data visualization options. You can narrow the search results by using filter criteria such as display currency, relative date, calendar month, week, year, company code, and so on, with visu- alization options such as table and chart views, changing dimensions and measures, and drill- ing up and down to view information. In essence, you can monitor contract consumption effectively, identifying underutilized or overuti- lized contracts. Furthermore, you can use the refresh option to update and view the latest data (the time since the last update will be dis- played—for example, showing that the available data is 15 minutes old). The app uses CDS view C_ CNTRLCONTRCNSMPNQRY to retrieve data. Using the Jump To option, you can navigate to the following apps: Manage Purchasing Catego- ries (F0337), Manage Central Purchase Contracts (F3144), Monitor Central Purchase Contract Items (F3492), Supplier (F0354), and Manage Pur- chasing Categories (F0337).
sections.he:
**Central Purchase Contract Consumption (Central Purchase Contract Consumption)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה אנליטית זו מסייעת לעקוב אחר ה-consumption של central purchase contracts, ומשווה את ה-released quantity מול ה-target quantity מהשנה הקודמת עד היום. היא תומכת בתובנות מהירות דרך אפשרויות סינון והמחשת נתונים גמישות. ניתן לצמצם את תוצאות החיפוש באמצעות קריטריוני סינון כגון display currency, relative date, calendar month, week, year, company code, וכן הלאה, עם אפשרויות המחשה כגון תצוגות table ו-chart, שינוי dimensions ו-measures, ו-drilling up ו-down. בעיקרון, ניתן לנטר contract consumption ביעילות, ולזהות contracts underutilized או overutilized. יתרה מכך, ניתן להשתמש באפשרות refresh לעדכון וצפייה בנתונים העדכניים ביותר. האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_CNTRLCONTRCNSMPNQRY לאחזור נתונים.
באמצעות אפשרות Jump To, ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות הבאות: Manage Purchasing Categories (F0337), Manage Central Purchase Contracts (F3144), Monitor Central Purchase Contract Items (F3492), ו-Supplier (F0354).

sections.title: Central Purchase Requisition Item Types
sections.en: Central Purchase Requisition Item Types (F3981) Application Type: Analytical This analytical app helps you view and analyze different types of purchase requisition items created in the SAP S/4HANA system (hub) and connected systems like SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You can view the total of pur- chase requisition items at a glance; analyze data by supplier, purchasing organization, material group, and more as KPIs; and filter results based on parameters such as relative dates, calendar year, month, week, quarter, vendor, company Personal Copy for 7 Materials Management 468 code, item category, and so on. In terms of data visualization, you can use chart and table view options; drill into specific details for purchase requisitions; adjust, for instance, the chart axes; and even export the data to a spreadsheet for further analysis. Overall, the app helps business users compare purchase requisition item counts and types across purchasing groups, suppliers, and systems; analyze and optimize purchasing processes based on detailed insights; and quickly navigate to related apps for monitoring and processing purchase requisition items. The app uses CDS view C_CNTRLPURREQNITEMTYPES. You can navigate to the Monitor Purchase Req- uisition Items Centrally app (F3976) and the Pro- cess Purchase Requisitions Centrally app (F3290). Tip The C_CNTRLPURREQNITTEMTYPES_CDS service (Central Purchase Requisition Item Types) must be activated in Transaction /IWFND/ MAINT_SERVICE (Activate and Maintain Ser- vices).
sections.he:
**Central Purchase Requisition Item Types (Central Purchase Requisition Item Types)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה אנליטית זו מסייעת לצפות ולנתח סוגים שונים של purchase requisition items שנוצרו במערכת SAP S/4HANA (hub) ו-connected systems כמו SAP ERP או SAP S/4HANA Cloud. ניתן לצפות בסך purchase requisition items במבט אחד; לנתח נתונים לפי supplier, purchasing organization, material group, ועוד כ-KPIs; ולסנן תוצאות על בסיס פרמטרים כגון relative dates, calendar year, month, week, quarter, vendor, company code, item category, וכן הלאה. מבחינת המחשת נתונים, ניתן להשתמש באפשרויות chart ו-table view; לבצע drill לפרטים ספציפיים; ואף לייצא נתונים ל-spreadsheet. האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_CNTRLPURREQNITEMTYPES.
ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות Monitor Purchase Requisition Items Centrally (F3976) ו-Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally (F3290).
**טיפ:** יש להפעיל את ה-service C_CNTRLPURREQNITTEMTYPES_CDS (Central Purchase Requisition Item Types) ב-Transaction /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE (Activate and Maintain Services).

sections.title: Classification-Based Product Hierarchy
sections.en: Classification-Based Product Hierarchy (F2351) Application Type: Transactional This app can be used to create and maintain product structures in hierarchies based on clas- sifications. This classification system supports better product management, reporting, and integration with processes like sales, procure- ment, and analytics. The app is used to manage product hierarchical structures for products, assigning products to nodes within the hierar- chy using predefined attributes. This app is useful as it can be used to visualize product hierarchies in a graphical or tabular view and to search and filter products based on their attributes or hierarchy levels. For example, in sales and distribution, product categorization can be used to segment product hierarchies for sales performance tracking, and in operational planning, products can be grouped based on attributes for procurement, manufacturing, or even distribution planning. The app uses CDS view C_MDPRODUCTHIERARCHYQUERY.
sections.he:
**Classification-Based Product Hierarchy (היררכיית מוצרים מבוססת-Classification)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו משמשת ליצירה ותחזוקה של מבני מוצרים בהיררכיות על בסיס classifications. מערכת classification זו תומכת ב-product management, reporting, ושילוב טובים יותר עם תהליכים כמו sales, procurement, ו-analytics. האפליקציה משמשת לניהול מבני product hierarchical עבור מוצרים, ומקצה מוצרים ל-nodes בתוך ההיררכיה באמצעות attributes מוגדרים-מראש.
אפליקציה זו שימושית בכך שניתן להשתמש בה להמחשת product hierarchies בתצוגה גרפית או טבלאית ולחיפוש וסינון מוצרים על בסיס ה-attributes או רמות ההיררכיה שלהם. לדוגמה, ב-sales and distribution, ניתן להשתמש ב-product categorization לפילוח product hierarchies למעקב sales performance, וב-operational planning, ניתן לקבץ מוצרים על בסיס attributes עבור procurement, manufacturing, או distribution planning. האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_MDPRODUCTHIERARCHYQUERY.

sections.title: Compare Supplier Quotations
sections.en: Compare Supplier Quotations (F2324) Application Type: Transactional This app allows you to evaluate and compare supplier quotations comprehensively. The app simplifies the supplier evaluation process by providing a side-by-side comparison of multiple supplier quotations for specific requests for quotations (RFQs). You can display all supplier quotations received for a specific RFQ. You can drill down to display the RFQs based on filter cri- teria such as RFQ, RFQ type, purchase document category, or RFQ description, or even search directly in the search bar. For a selected RFQ, you can view details such as who created the RFQ, its status (e.g., in process), the quotation deadline, the number of invited bidders, and a compari- son of the target value and best quotation. Within the app, you can assign scores to suppli- ers and highlight the best quotation based on overall score or specific attributes based on available data. You also can compare quotations from multiple suppliers for a specific purchase request and view detailed information, such as pricing, delivery dates, payment terms, and con- ditions. You can only compare and award quota- tions in the Submitted status. Selecting the Supplier hyperlink shows a popup where you can navigate to various apps such as Supplier (F0354), Clear Outgoing Payments (F1367), Display Supplier Balances (F0701A), Manage Supplier Line Items (F0712), Post Outgo- ing Payments (1612), and many more using the More Links option. Tip You can customize the options that show up in the Supplier hyperlink popup screen by using the More Links option to define a quick link list of up to 20 apps. © 469 7 Materials Management Note that appropriate authorization is required for you to access the various related apps.
sections.he:
**Compare Supplier Quotations (השוואת Supplier Quotations)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מאפשרת להעריך ולהשוות ביסודיות supplier quotations. האפליקציה מפשטת את תהליך ה-supplier evaluation על ידי מתן השוואה זו-לצד-זו של supplier quotations מרובים עבור requests for quotations (RFQs) ספציפיים. ניתן להציג את כל ה-supplier quotations שהתקבלו עבור RFQ ספציפי. ניתן לבצע drill-down להצגת RFQs על בסיס קריטריוני סינון כגון RFQ, RFQ type, purchase document category, או RFQ description. עבור RFQ נבחר, ניתן לצפות בפרטים כגון מי יצר את ה-RFQ, ה-status שלו (לדוגמה, in process), ה-quotation deadline, מספר ה-invited bidders, והשוואה של ה-target value וה-best quotation. בתוך האפליקציה, ניתן להקצות scores ל-suppliers ולהבליט את ה-best quotation על בסיס overall score או attributes ספציפיים. ניתן גם להשוות quotations מ-suppliers מרובים עבור purchase request ספציפי ולצפות במידע מפורט, כגון pricing, delivery dates, payment terms, ו-conditions. ניתן להשוות ולהעניק (award) quotations רק ב-status Submitted.
בחירת היפר-קישור ה-Supplier מציגה popup שבו ניתן לנווט לאפליקציות שונות כגון Supplier (F0354), Clear Outgoing Payments (F1367), Display Supplier Balances (F0701A), Manage Supplier Line Items (F0712), Post Outgoing Payments (F1612), ועוד באמצעות אפשרות More Links.
**טיפ:** ניתן להתאים את האפשרויות המופיעות ב-popup של היפר-קישור ה-Supplier באמצעות אפשרות More Links להגדרת quick link list של עד 20 אפליקציות.

sections.title: Compare Supplier Quotations (Sourcing Project)
sections.en: Compare Supplier Quotations (Sourcing Project) (F4863) Application Type: Transactional This app is designed for strategic procurement. It allows you to compare supplier quotations within sourcing projects and helps procurement teams evaluate suppliers based on cost, terms, and other key factors. You will need to enter a sourcing project ID on the initial screen or alter- natively use filters to narrow down sourcing projects by version, type, status (published, revised, canceled, etc.), name, and other criteria. You can customize the table view by selecting which columns to display, such as company code, bidders, material group, and document currency. You can compare multiple supplier quotations within a sourcing project by viewing different versions of the same quotation and identifying the best bid for each item across, for instance, submitted and revised quotations. Selected quotations can be opened in the Man- age Supplier Quotations app (F4862) to check statuses, proposed delivery dates, notes, attach- ments, and version history. The app also calcu- lates the total cost of quote items in a sourcing project; based on the comparison, you can cre- ate awarding scenarios to select the most suit- able supplier and initiate negotiations. Quota- tions that have not yet been awarded can be revised and edited as needed. Tip The UI_SRCGPROJ_COMPARE service (Sourcing Project Quotation Comparison) should be activated and maintained for full functional- ity.
sections.he:
**Compare Supplier Quotations (Sourcing Project) (השוואת Supplier Quotations – Sourcing Project)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מתוכננת ל-strategic procurement. היא מאפשרת להשוות supplier quotations בתוך sourcing projects ומסייעת ל-procurement teams להעריך suppliers על בסיס cost, terms, וגורמי מפתח אחרים. יש להזין sourcing project ID במסך הראשוני או לחלופין להשתמש במסננים לצמצום sourcing projects לפי version, type, status (published, revised, canceled, וכו'), name, וקריטריונים אחרים. ניתן להתאים את תצוגת ה-table על ידי בחירת אילו columns להציג, כגון company code, bidders, material group, ו-document currency. ניתן להשוות supplier quotations מרובים בתוך sourcing project על ידי צפייה ב-versions שונים של אותה quotation וזיהוי ה-best bid עבור כל item. quotations נבחרים ניתנים לפתיחה באפליקציית Manage Supplier Quotations (F4862). האפליקציה גם מחשבת את ה-total cost של quote items ב-sourcing project; על בסיס ההשוואה, ניתן ליצור awarding scenarios לבחירת ה-supplier המתאים ביותר וליזום negotiations.
**טיפ:** יש להפעיל ולתחזק את ה-service UI_SRCGPROJ_COMPARE (Sourcing Project Quotation Comparison) לפונקציונליות מלאה.

sections.title: Confirm Receipt of Goods – New
sections.en: Confirm Receipt of Goods – New (F4489) Application Type: Transactional This app simplifies the goods receipt confirma- tion process in procurement. This app is tar- geted at business users responsible for confirm- ing that goods or services ordered have been received or rendered in accordance. You can dis- play a list of purchase orders awaiting confirma- tion of goods receipt. The app is quite useful for business users who are responsible for confirm- ing that goods and services requested have been delivered or rendered. The app lists all the pur- chase requisitions even from other users in other departments of an organization with the relevant authorizations. You can easily confirm the receipt of goods or services linked to pur- chase orders or service entry sheets and indicate full or partial deliveries. The app lists all pur- chase requisitions with material items relevant for confirmation. All purchase requisitions from numerous process areas are listed and can be confirmed as required. The app supports partial goods receipt confirmations by entering the quantity received and not selecting the Final Delivery icon. If the full quantity has been received, you can select Final Delivery to indi- cate completion. The app allows you to confirm goods receipts for one or multiple items consec- utively. More importantly, users with the appro- priate authorization can view purchase requisi- tions from different departments, and the system centralizes all procurement requests, making it easier to track outstanding goods receipts. This app is the successor to Confirm Goods Receipt (F1654), which was deprecated as of SAP S/4HANA 2020 FPS02.
sections.he:
**Confirm Receipt of Goods – New (אישור קבלת Goods – חדש)** — Application Type: Transactional.
אפליקציה זו מפשטת את תהליך אישור ה-goods receipt ב-procurement. אפליקציה זו מכוונת ל-business users האחראים לאשר ש-goods או services שהוזמנו התקבלו או סופקו בהתאם. ניתן להציג רשימה של purchase orders הממתינים לאישור goods receipt. האפליקציה מציגה את כל ה-purchase requisitions אף ממשתמשים אחרים במחלקות אחרות בארגון עם ה-authorizations הרלוונטיים. ניתן לאשר בקלות את קבלת ה-goods או services המקושרים ל-purchase orders או service entry sheets ולציין deliveries מלאים או חלקיים. האפליקציה תומכת ב-partial goods receipt confirmations על ידי הזנת ה-quantity received ואי-בחירת אייקון Final Delivery. אם הכמות המלאה התקבלה, ניתן לבחור Final Delivery לציון השלמה. האפליקציה מאפשרת לאשר goods receipts עבור item אחד או מרובים ברצף. חשוב יותר, משתמשים עם ה-authorization המתאים יכולים לצפות ב-purchase requisitions ממחלקות שונות, והמערכת מרכזת את כל ה-procurement requests.
אפליקציה זו היא היורשת ל-Confirm Goods Receipt (F1654), שהפכה deprecated החל מ-SAP S/4HANA 2020 FPS02.

sections.title: Contract Expiry
sections.en: Contract Expiry (F0574) Application Type: Analytical This app helps you track and manage expiring contracts effectively. It provides real-time Personal Copy for 7 Materials Management 470 insights into contracts approaching their end date within the next 90 days, which enables businesses to renew, renegotiate, or close con- tracts in time. This app supports proactive con- tract lifecycle management, which in turn helps businesses maintain supplier relationships and prevent supply disruptions. The app displays the number of contracts approaching their expira- tion at the top of the screen (Contracts Approaching End Date). You can view details such as contract number, supplier, expiration date, target amount (total contract value), released amount (amount already utilized), and so on. Furthermore, the app visualizes expiring contracts using KPIs: Supplier, Purchasing Group, Purchasing Organization, Purchasing Document Category, and more. The following mini tiles are available: ▪ Contract Expiry Displays the number of contracts that are nearing their expiration date. ▪ Off-Contract Spend Highlights purchase orders that have been created without referencing a contract. Selecting this tile navigates you to the SAP Smart Business Runtime app (F5240). ▪ Contract Leakage Identifies purchase orders that should have referenced existing contracts but did not. ▪ Quantity Contract Consumption Provides insights into how much of the agreed quantity in a contract has been released versus the total target quantity. ▪ Value Contract Consumption Displays the monetary release amount in relation to the target contract value. ▪ PO and Scheduling Agreement Value Presents a comparison between actual and planned purchasing spend. Like some other tiles, it also links to the SAP Smart Business Runtime app for further analysis. You also can navigate to various apps using the Jump To option, such as Manage Purchase Con- tracts (F3144), Supplier (F0354), and My Purchas- ing Document Items (F0574B). The app uses CDS view C_PURCHASECONTRACTEXPIRY to retrieve data as one of its views. Tips SAP recommends that valid conversion/ exchange rates be maintained in the system for the mini tiles’ data to be loaded properly; see SAP Note 3133298. To maintain missing exchange rates for various purchasing docu- ments (purchase orders, contracts, etc.), use the Analyze Missing Exchange Rates app (F4360). The OData services MM_PUR_PO_SPEND_ANALY- SIS (Purchase Order Spend), C_PURCHASECON- TRACTEXPIRY_CDS (Purchase Contract Expiry), and more should be activated and maintained for this app.
sections.he:
**Contract Expiry (Contract Expiry)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מסייעת לעקוב ולנהל ביעילות contracts שתוקפם פג. היא מספקת תובנות בזמן אמת ל-contracts המתקרבים ל-end date שלהם בתוך 90 הימים הבאים, מה שמאפשר לעסקים לחדש, לנהל משא ומתן מחדש, או לסגור contracts בזמן. אפליקציה זו תומכת ב-proactive contract lifecycle management. האפליקציה מציגה את מספר ה-contracts המתקרבים לתפוגתם בראש המסך (Contracts Approaching End Date). ניתן לצפות בפרטים כגון contract number, supplier, expiration date, target amount (total contract value), released amount (amount already utilized), וכן הלאה. יתרה מכך, האפליקציה ממחישה contracts שתוקפם פג באמצעות KPIs: Supplier, Purchasing Group, Purchasing Organization, Purchasing Document Category, ועוד. ה-mini tiles הבאים זמינים:
▪ Contract Expiry — מציג את מספר ה-contracts המתקרבים ל-expiration date.
▪ Off-Contract Spend — מבליט purchase orders שנוצרו ללא הפניה ל-contract. בחירת tile זה מנווטת לאפליקציית SAP Smart Business Runtime (F5240).
▪ Contract Leakage — מזהה purchase orders שהיו צריכים להפנות ל-contracts קיימים אך לא עשו זאת.
▪ Quantity Contract Consumption — מספק תובנות לכמה מהכמות המוסכמת ב-contract שוחררה מול ה-total target quantity.
▪ Value Contract Consumption — מציג את ה-monetary release amount ביחס ל-target contract value.
▪ PO and Scheduling Agreement Value — מציג השוואה בין purchasing spend בפועל למתוכנן.
ניתן גם לנווט לאפליקציות שונות באמצעות אפשרות Jump To, כגון Manage Purchase Contracts (F3144), Supplier (F0354), ו-My Purchasing Document Items (F0574B). האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_PURCHASECONTRACTEXPIRY לאחזור נתונים.
**טיפים:** SAP ממליצה לתחזק במערכת conversion/exchange rates תקפים כדי שנתוני ה-mini tiles ייטענו כראוי; עיין ב-SAP Note 3133298. לתחזוקת exchange rates חסרים, השתמש באפליקציית Analyze Missing Exchange Rates (F4360). יש להפעיל ולתחזק את ה-OData services MM_PUR_PO_SPEND_ANALYSIS (Purchase Order Spend), C_PURCHASECONTRACTEXPIRY_CDS (Purchase Contract Expiry), ועוד.

sections.title: Contract Leakage
sections.en: Contract Leakage (F0681) Application Type: Analytical This app provides insights to help track and manage purchases made outside of agreed- upon contracts, a scenario known as contract leakage. This app allows you to identify pur- chase orders that lack a contract reference even when an existing contract could have been used. By viewing this data, you can determine the net value of noncontract purchases, assess the per- centage of spend outside contracts (leakage %), and pinpoint suppliers or categories with high leakage rates, which in effect allows organiza- tions to improve contract compliance and improve supplier negotiations and purchasing efficiency. You can apply various filters, such as supplier, purchasing category, company code, plant, material, work breakdown structure (WBS) element, and many more, to refine your analy- ses. The app provides KPIs to monitor contract adherence and track procurement trends. It also integrates with other apps, such as Manage Pur- chasing Categories (F0337) and Purchase Order (F038A), for further processing. The Refresh option and mini tiles enable comprehensive usability by keeping data updated and accessi- ble. The app uses CDS view C_PURCHASECONTRACT- LEAKAGE to retrieve data. © 471 7 Materials Management
sections.he:
**Contract Leakage (Contract Leakage)** — Application Type: Analytical.
אפליקציה זו מספקת תובנות לסיוע במעקב וניהול רכישות שבוצעו מחוץ ל-contracts מוסכמים, תרחיש הידוע כ-contract leakage. אפליקציה זו מאפשרת לזהות purchase orders החסרים contract reference גם כאשר ניתן היה להשתמש ב-contract קיים. על ידי צפייה בנתונים אלה, ניתן לקבוע את ה-net value של רכישות non-contract, להעריך את אחוז ה-spend מחוץ ל-contracts (leakage %), ולאתר suppliers או categories עם leakage rates גבוהים, מה שמאפשר לארגונים לשפר contract compliance ולשפר supplier negotiations ו-purchasing efficiency. ניתן להחיל מסננים שונים, כגון supplier, purchasing category, company code, plant, material, work breakdown structure (WBS) element, ועוד רבים, לחידוד הניתוחים.
האפליקציה מספקת KPIs לניטור contract adherence ומעקב אחר מגמות procurement. היא גם משתלבת עם אפליקציות אחרות, כגון Manage Purchasing Categories (F0337) ו-Purchase Order (F0348A). האפליקציה משתמשת ב-CDS view C_PURCHASECONTRACTLEAKAGE לאחזור נתונים.

sections.title: Contribute to Sourcing Projects
sections.en: Contribute to Sourcing Projects (F7757) Application Type: Transactional This app helps you manage and work together with others on sourcing projects by providing a central, easy-to-use platform for both strategic and demand-based sourcing activities. It enables process owners to actively contribute to supplier selection, tendering, and contract nego- tiation activities. Key functionalities include inviting preferred suppliers to participate in sourcing events, adding legal or relevant sup- porting documents to sourcing projects, and evaluating, comparing, and negotiating supplier quotations. You also can create awarding scenar- ios to select the most suitable quotations and generate follow-on documents such as purchase orders or central purchase contracts based on the awarded bids.
